75.translation: Alla - moolu te suutee moo la fo A ye, Ñaŋo Katilaa, [bɛɛ] Lafitalaa. Sindiyaa walla suunoo te A muta. Soomu jamalu nunu fanan fɔ A fe. Jommaa le mu min bɛ sɔrɔda A kan fo A suutoo la? A londii min be ŋo kan nin min be ŋo kɔŋo, ŋo te fɛɛru A dɔnniyaa la fɔ A sɔŋo. A Kursiyaa jaajii soomu jamalu nunu fanan fɔ A fe, ŋo lafitalaa te A tanŋo. A le mu Sanŋalaa, Bɛlaa.

76.translation: ([Soorah al-Ikhlaas (112)]( 1 )   Fɔ, A le mu Alla, Kelenŋo,( 2 )   Alla, Abadaa Dulaa.( 3 )   A ma ŋindi, A ma ŋindaa,( 4 )   moolu te A seesaani.)([Soorah al-Falaq (113)] ( 1 )   Fɔ, n dɔŋ sɔɔŋo Maraa la( 2 )   jumaŋo min A daadaa( 3 )   nin jumaŋo looŋo ŋa ŋaŋo( 4 )   nin jumaŋo pɔpɔlaalu suutoo la( 5 )   nin jumaŋo hasidiyaa ŋa hasidi. )([Soorah an-Naas (114)])( 1 )   Fɔ, n dɔŋ moolu Maraa la,( 2 )   moolu Mansa.( 3 )   moolu Alla,( 4 )   jumaŋo waswasaa bantaaba -( 5 )   min waswasaa [jumaŋo] moolu ɲaaŋo la -( 6 )   jinn nin moolu.
76.instruction: O kɔŋo karandi [Soorah al-Ikhlaas (112)], [Soorah al-Falaq (113)] nin [Soorah an-Naas (114)]

77.translation: 'An be sɔɔŋo la, wakkati ŋoo fanan fɔ Alla la, laafitalaa bɛɛ, tanuu bɛɛ fɔ Alla la. Moolu te suutee moo la fo Alla ye, A kelenŋo, alaa mɔɔ A seesaani, A ye laafitalaa bɛɛ nin tanuu bɛɛ, A se bɛɛ la. N Maraa, n I ɲini ŋaŋo ŋoo la ɲoo nin min nɔɔŋo ɲoo, n dɔŋ I la jumaŋo ŋaŋo ŋoo la nin jumaŋo min nɔɔŋo. N Maraa, n dɔŋ I la faaŋaaleŋo nin foroyaa forobaa la. N Maraa, n dɔŋ I la Tasuma jaŋŋaŋo nin saama jaŋŋaŋo la.'
77.instruction: Asbahna wa-asbahal-mulku lillah walhamdu lillah la ilaha illal-lah, wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeer, rabbi as-aluka khayra ma fee hathihil-laylah, wakhayra ma baAAdaha, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharri hathihil-laylah, washarri ma baAAdaha, rabbi aAAoothu bika minal-kasal, wasoo-il kibar, rabbi aAAoothu bika min AAathabin fin-nar, waAAathabin fil-qabr.‘We have reached the morning and at this very time unto Allah belongs all sovereignty, and all praise is for Allah.  None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this night and the good of what follows it and I take refuge in You from the evil of this night and the evil of what follows it.  My Lord, I take refuge in You from laziness and senility.  My Lord, I take refuge in You from torment in the Fire and punishment in the grave.’…likewise, one says in the morning:Amsayna wa-amsal-mulku lillah….‘We have reached the evening and at this very time unto Allah belongs all sovereignty…’

78.translation: (Alla, I nɔɔ na an be sɔɔŋo la, I nɔɔ na an be suunoo la, I nɔɔ na an be ɲaŋo la an saaya, I le la an naa.)[Suunoo la:](Alla, I nɔɔ na an be suunoo la, I nɔɔ na an be sɔɔŋo la, I nɔɔ na an be ɲaŋo la an saaya, I le la an siiŋo.)
78.instruction: (Allahumma bika asbahna wabika amsayna, wabika nahya ,wabika namootu wa-ilaykan-nushoor.)[In the evening:] (Allahumma bika amsayna, wabika asbahna, wabika nahya wabika namootu wa-ilaykal-maseer.)

79.translation: (Alla, I le mu n Maraa, moolu te suutee moo la fo I ye, I daadaa n, n le mu I baaroo, n be I liɲaa nin I daamuŋo kan n waawoo bɛɛ la, n dɔŋ I la jumaŋo n kɛ. N I moƴƴo kan dɔnnoo, n n juŋoo kan dɔnnoo, o ka n haŋŋa, juŋoo te haŋŋa fo I ye.)
79.instruction: (Allahumma anta rabbee la ilaha illa ant, khalaqtanee wa-ana AAabduk, wa-ana AAala AAahdika wawaAAdika mas-tataAAt, aAAoothu bika min sharri ma sanaAAt, aboo-o laka biniAAmatika AAalay, wa-aboo-o bithanbee, faghfir lee fa-innahu la yaghfiruth-thunooba illa ant.)

80.translation: (Alla, n be sɔɔŋo la, n I le kii, I kursiyaa boobalaalu, I malaa'ikalu, nin I daadaa bɛɛ seere: I le mu Alla, moolu te suutee moo la fo I ye, kelenŋo, alaa mɔɔ I seesaani, Muhammad le mu I baaroo nin I Kɛmɛ.) (naani sɔɔŋo nin suunoo)(Kiliŋoo: suunoo la, moo karan (amsaytu) (asbahtu) nɔɔŋo.)
80.instruction: (Allahumma innee asbahtu oshhiduk, wa-oshhidu hamalata AAarshik, wamala-ikatak, wajameeAAa khalqik, annaka antal-lahu la ilaha illa ant, wahdaka la shareeka lak, wa-anna Muhammadan AAabduka warasooluk .) (naani sɔɔŋo nin suunoo)(Kiliŋoo: suunoo la, moo karan (amsaytu) (asbahtu) nɔɔŋo.)

81.translation: (Alla, niima min n sɔɔŋo, walla I daadaa jommaa fanan fɔ, ko I kelenŋo, alaa mɔɔ I seesaani, I le la tanuu bɛɛ I le la jetto bɛɛ.)(...moo min fɔ ŋoo sɔɔŋo la o hokki a ŋaŋo jetto, moo min fɔ ŋoo suunoo la o hokki a suunoo jetto.)(Kiliŋoo: suunoo la, moo karan (amsa) (asbaha) nɔɔŋo.)
81.instruction: (Allahumma ma asbaha bee min niAAmatin, aw bi-ahadin min khalqik, faminka wahdaka la shareeka lak, falakal-hamdu walakash-shukr.)(Kiliŋoo: suunoo la, moo karan (amsa) (asbaha) nɔɔŋo.)

82.translation: (Alla, hokku n ɲaaŋo weltal, Alla, hokku n taaŋo weltal, Alla, hokku n ɲaa weltal. Moolu te suutee moo la fo I ye.)(saboo) (Alla, n dɔŋ I la kufr nin yontaa la, n dɔŋ I la saama jaŋŋaŋo la. Moolu te suutee moo la fo I ye. (saboo))
82.instruction: (Allahumma AAafinee fee badanee, allahumma AAafinee fee samAAee, allahumma AAafinee fee basaree, la ilaha illa ant.(saboo).)(Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika minal-kufr, walfaqr, wa-aAAoothu bika min AAathabil-qabr, la ilaha illa ant (saboo).)

83.translation: Alla heeɓi n, moolu te suutee moo la fo A ye, A kan n dɔŋ, A le mu kursiyaa bɛlaa Maraa.' (Karandi jeeɗiɗi Arabic la.)
83.instruction: (Hasbiyal-lahu la ilaha illa huwa, AAalayhi tawakkalt, wahuwa rabbul-AAarshil-AAatheem (Karandi jeeɗiɗi Arabic la.)

84.translation: Alla, n I ɲini yaafaraa nin weltal aduna ŋoo la nin abadaa. Alla, n I ɲini yaafaraa nin weltal n deenoo la nin aduna ŋoo la, nin n moolu nin n jawoo. Alla, moo n ɗaalilu, weltina n hulɓinle. Alla, lafitalaa n kan nin n kɔŋo nin n kan kinya nin n kan kan nin n sanŋa, n dɔŋ I sanŋalaa la leydi liɓa n.
84.instruction: Allahumma innee as-alukal-AAafwa walAAafiyah, fid-dunya wal-akhirah, allahumma innee as-alukal-AAafwa walAAafiyah fee deenee, wadunyaya wa-ahlee, wamalee, allahummas-tur AAawratee, wa-amin rawAAatee, allahummah-fathnee min bayni yaday, wamin khalfee, waAAan yameenee, waAAan shimalee, wamin fawqee, wa-aAAoothu biAAathamatika an oghtala min tahtee.

85.translation: (Alla, Anndulaa suuɗoo nin bayyinoo, Daadaa soomu jamalu nin leydi, Maraa nin Mansaa fɛɛnu bɛɛ, n seere moolu te suutee moo la fo I ye. N dɔŋ I la n neɗɗaagal jumaŋo la, jumaŋo nin shirk seytaan la, nin jumaŋo kɛŋo n neɗɗaagal la walla o ɓaddi muslim goɗɗo la.)(shirk: moolu goɗɗo bolee Alla la fɛɛnu minnu fɔ A fe. O bɛ se (1) laadamini la, yeru laadamini moo goɗɗo fo Alla se nafa kɛŋo walla jumaŋo kɛŋo, (2) kuma la, yeru woondoo moo goɗɗo kan fo Alla, nin (3) baara la, yeru ʋuuɗoo walla suujudoo moo goɗɗo kan fo Alla.)
85.instruction: (Allahumma AAalimal-ghaybi washshahadah, fatiras-samawati wal-ard, rabba kulli shayin wamaleekah, ashhadu an la ilaha illa ant, aAAoothu bika min sharri nafsee wamin sharrish-shaytani washirkih, waan aqtarifa AAala nafsee soo-an aw ajurrahu ila muslim.)

86.translation: (Alla taa la, min taa la fɛɛnu te jumaŋo leydi la walla soomu la, A le mu Yeeɓoo Bɛɛ, Anndulaa Bɛɛ.'(saboo))
86.instruction: (Bismil-lahil-lathee la yadurru maAAas-mihi shay-on fil-ardi wala fis-sama-i wahuwas-sameeAAul-AAaleem. (three times).)

87.translation: (N jaɓi Alla Maraa la, Lislaam deenoo la, Muhammad Kɛmɛ la.'(saboo))
87.instruction: (Radeetu billahi rabban wabil-islami deenan wabiMuhammadin  nabiyya. (three times))

88.translation: (E Ñaŋo Katilaa, E Hoɗɗo Hoore mum Lafitalaa Bɛɛ, I hinɛ la n dɔŋ balloo, feewna n koɗɗaɗe bɛɛ, I acca n hoore n la, hali ɲaa wittugoo la.)
88.instruction: (Ya hayyu ya qayyoom, birahmatika astagheeth, aslih lee sha/nee kullah, wala takilnee ila nafsee tarfata AAayn.)

89.translation: (An be sɔɔŋo la, wakkati ŋoo laafitalaa bɛɛ fɔ Alla la, adunaaruuji Maraa. Alla, n I ɲini ŋaŋo ŋoo la ɲoo, a fathoo nin a yaljere, a lewru nin a barkeeji nin a fewindoo, n dɔŋ I la ŋaŋo ŋoo la jumaŋo nin jumaŋo min nɔɔŋo.)[Suunoo la, ɗu'aa karanetee no ɗoo:](An be suunoo la, wakkati ŋoo laafitalaa bɛɛ fɔ Alla la, adunaaruuji Maraa. Alla, n I ɲini suunoo ŋoo la ɲoo, a fathoo nin a yaljere, a lewru nin a barkeeji nin a fewindoo, n dɔŋ I la suunoo ŋoo la jumaŋo nin jumaŋo min nɔɔŋo.)
89.instruction: (Asbahna wa-asbahal-mulku lillahi rabbil-AAalameen, allahumma innee as-aluka khayra hathal-yawm, fat-hahu, wanasrahu, wanoorahu, wabarakatahu, wahudahu, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharri ma feehi, washarri ma baAAdah.)[For the evening, the supplication is read as follows: ](Amsayna wa-amsal-mulku lillahi rabbil-AAalameen, allahumma innee as-aluka khayra hathihil-laylah, fat-haha, wanasraha, wanooraha, wabarakataha, wahudaha, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharri ma feeha washarri ma baAAdaha.)

90.translation: (An be Lislaam fitrah kan, laadamin laŋo kelenŋo kan, an Kɛmɛ Muhammad deenoo kan nin an marambaa Ibraheem deenoo kan, min wonnoo muslim goongaŋo, A ma won moolu goɗɗo boleeɓe Alla la.)(fitrah: Lislaam deenoo, Ibraheem sira.)(Kiliŋoo: suunoo la, moo karan amsayna asbahna nɔɔŋo.)
90.instruction: (Asbahna AAala fitratil-islam, waAAala kalimatil-ikhlas, waAAala deeni nabiyyina Muhammad  waAAala millati abeena Ibraheem, haneefan musliman wama kana minal-mushrikeen.)(Note: for the evening, one reads amsayna instead of asbahna.)

92.translation: (Moolu te suutee moo la fo Alla ye, A kelenŋo, alaa mɔɔ A seesaani, A ye laafitalaa bɛɛ nin tanuu bɛɛ, A se bɛɛ la.)( [sappo walla kelen so moo waaɗi])
92.instruction: (La ilaha illal-lah, wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shay-in qadeer.  [sappo walla kelen so moo waaɗi])

93.translation: (Moolu te suutee moo la fo Alla ye, A kelenŋo, alaa mɔɔ A seesaani, A ye laafitalaa bɛɛ nin tanuu bɛɛ, A se bɛɛ la.)((wolde teemedere ŋaŋo kala))
93.instruction: (La ilaha illal-lah, wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shay-in qadeer. (wolde teemedere ŋaŋo kala))

94.translation: (Alla meeñaani, n tantana A A daadaa limoo la nin A jaɓɗe la, A kursiyaa daasu la nin A konnguɗi sɛbɛɛ la.)(saboo)
94.instruction: (Subhanal-lahi wabihamdih, AAadada khalqihi warida nafsih, wazinata AAarshih, wamidada kalimatih.)(saboo)

95.translation: (Alla, n I ɲini dɔnniyaa nafaa, riziqi moƴƴo, nin baara jaɓɓaala.)
95.instruction: (Allahumma innee as-aluka AAilman nafiAAan, warizqan tayyiban, waAAamalan mutaqabbalan.)

96.translation: 'N Alla yaafaraa ɲini, n ruttoto A la tobubugoo la.' [wolde teemedere ŋaŋo la]
96.instruction: Astaghfirullaaha wa 'atoobu 'ilayhi[one hundred times a day]

97.translation: (N dɔŋ Alla laŋo timmuɗi la jumaŋo A daadaa.)(saboo suunoo la)
97.instruction: (aAAoothu bikalimatil-lahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq.) (saboo suunoo la)

98.translation: 'Alla, nela salaat nin jam an Kɛmɛ Muhammad kan.' [sappo]
98.instruction: Allaahumma salli wa sallim 'alaa Nabiyyinaa Muhammadin[ten times]

99.translation: (Saŋa a siiŋo la ŋaŋo kala, Nelaaɗo ɗon juboo a junngooji, pɔpɔ (pɔpɔgol ko ɓuri yem nin ndokku tutti) nder ŋo, karandi Kuraan soorah saba cakkitiiɗi (Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq, An-Nas) ɓaawo o a yoomba a ɲaaŋo bɛɛ a waawoo la a junngooji la, a fuɗɓoo a bɔɔ nin a ɲiina ɓaawo o ɲaaŋo taƴre bɛɛ, a ɗon waɗa ɗoo saboo.)

100.translation: Alla - moolu te suutee moo la fo A ye, Ñaŋo Katilaa, [bɛɛ] Lafitalaa. Sindiyaa walla suunoo te A muta. Soomu jamalu nunu fanan fɔ A fe. Jommaa le mu min bɛ sɔrɔda A kan fo A suutoo la? A londii min be ŋo kan nin min be ŋo kɔŋo, ŋo te fɛɛru A dɔnniyaa la fɔ A sɔŋo. A Kursiyaa jaajii soomu jamalu nunu fanan fɔ A fe, ŋo lafitalaa te A tanŋo. A le mu Sanŋalaa, Bɛlaa.

102.translation: (I taa la n Maraa, n fonndii, I taa la n wuli, so I ittii n neɗɗaagal yurma ɗo, so I ruttinii n neɗɗaagal toppita ɗo e laawal I toppitata I baaroo goongaŋo.)
102.instruction: (Bismika rabbee wadaAAtu janbee wabika arfaAAuh, fa-in amsakta nafsee farhamha, wa-in arsaltaha fahfathha bima tahfathu bihi AAibadakas-saliheen.)

103.translation: (Alla, I daadaa n neɗɗaagal, I le ittata o, I le la o saayaa nin o ɲaŋo. So I hokkii n neɗɗaagal ɲaŋo toppita o, so I ittii o ɲaŋo yaafara o. Alla, n I ɲini hokku n weltal.)
103.instruction: (Allahumma innaka khalaqta nafsee wa-anta tawaffaha, laka mamatuha wamahyaha in ahyaytaha fahfathha, wa-in amattaha faghfir laha. Allahumma innee as-alukal-AAafiyah.)

104.translation: (Alla, toppita n e I jaŋŋaŋo la ŋalŋo I baaroolu wulita.)

105.translation: (I taa la Alla, n ɲaŋo n saaya.)

106.translation: (Alla meeñaani. (cappande saba nin saba) Tanuu bɛɛ fɔ Alla la. (cappande saba nin saba) Alla bɛlaa. (cappande saba nin naani))
106.instruction: (Subhanal-lah. (cappande saba nin saba) Alhamdu lillah. (cappande saba nin saba) Allahu akbar. (cappande saba nin naani))

107.translation: (Alla, Maraa soomu jamalu joweeɗɗi nin kursiyaa bɛlaa, an Maraa nin Maraa fɛɛnu bɛɛ, Fooyoo tuuru nin naŋo, Ummiinuɗo Tawraat, Injiil nin Furqaan, n dɔŋ I la fɛɛnu bɛɛ jumaŋo I mutata a boŋŋo la (ko woni I laami bɛɛ). Alla, I le mu Fuɗɓoowo, fɛɛnu te I kan, I le mu Cakkitiiɗo, fɛɛnu te I nɔɔŋo. I le mu Aththahir, fɛɛnu te I sanŋa, I le mu Al-Batin, fɛɛnu te ɓadii I. Yoɓ an jaaɓɗe, heeɓna an yontaa la.)(Tawraat: deftere ummiinaa Moosa la.)(Injiil: deftere ummiinaa Easa la.)(Furqaan: innde Kuraan inndeelu nder, maanaa: Roggoo min rokkoo goonga nin fewre.)(Aththahir: jirtaa A halluɗi mawninde nin daadaa kala tuttingol A mawninde nin A sanŋalaa la, sabu A sanŋa A daadaa bɛɛ e nderka A nin halluɗi A.)(Al-Batin: jirtaa A faamoo nin A dɔnnoo suuɗoo bɛɛ, min be ɲaaŋo la nin fɛɛnu ɓuri hirtaade, no o jirtirta A ɓadiiɗe nin A ɓadiiɗe bɛɛ e laawal moƴƴo A teddungal.)
107.instruction: (Allahumma rabbas-samawatis-sabAA, warabbal-AAarshil-AAatheem, rabbana warabba kulli shay/, faliqal-habbi wannawa, wamunazzilat-tawra, wal-injeel, walfurqan, aAAoothu bika min sharri kulli shayin anta akhithun binasiyatih. Allahumma antal-awwal, falaysa qablaka shay/, wa-antal-akhir, falaysa baAAdaka shay/, wa-antath-thahir falaysa fawqaka shay/, waantal-batin, falaysa doonaka shay/, iqdi AAannad-dayna wa-aghnina minal-faqr.)

108.translation: (Tanuu bɛɛ fɔ Alla, mo ɲaami an hokkii an yarndam, mo heeɓi an mooftii an, ɓee ɗuuɗɓe alaa heeɓɗo walla mooftoowo.)
108.instruction: (Alhamdu lillahil-lathee atAAamana wasaqana, wakafana, wa-awana, fakam mimman la kafiya lahu wala mu'wee.)

109.translation: (Alla, Anndulaa suuɗoo nin bayyinoo, Daadaa soomu jamalu nin leydi, Maraa nin Mansaa fɛɛnu bɛɛ, n seere moolu te suutee moo la fo I ye. N dɔŋ I la n neɗɗaagal jumaŋo la, jumaŋo nin shirk seytaan la, nin jumaŋo kɛŋo n neɗɗaagal la walla o ɓaddi muslim goɗɗo la.)(shirk: moolu goɗɗo bolee Alla la fɛɛnu minnu fɔ A fe. O bɛ se (1) laadamini la, yeru laadamini moo goɗɗo fo Alla se nafa kɛŋo walla jumaŋo kɛŋo, (2) kuma la, yeru woondoo moo goɗɗo kan fo Alla, nin (3) baara la, yeru ʋuuɗoo walla suujudoo moo goɗɗo kan fo Alla.)
109.instruction: (Allahumma AAalimal-ghaybi washshahadah, fatiras-samawati wal-ard, rabba kulli shayin wamaleekah, ashhadu an la ilaha illa ant, aAAoothu bika min sharri nafsee wamin sharrish-shaytani washirkih, waan aqtarifa AAala nafsee soo-an aw ajurrahu ila muslim.)

110.translation: (Nelaaɗo taa fonndaa fo a karandi Soorat As-Sajdah (kapitil 32) nin Soorat Al-Mulk (kapitil 67).)

111.translation: (Alla, n hokkii n neɗɗaagal I la, n kaɗii n koɗɗal I la, n hollitii n ɲiina I la, n dɔŋ I la tiinɗo, e muuyde nin kulle I la. Tigi alaa dulaa walla kisal e I so e I. N laadamini I Deftere I ummiini, n laadamini I Kɛmɛ I nelaa.)(So I saayi, I saayata e fitrah kan.)(fitrah: Lislaam deenoo, Ibraheem sira.)
111.instruction: (Allahumma aslamtu nafsee ilayk, wafawwadtu amree ilayk, wawajjahtu wajhee ilayk, wa-alja/tu thahree ilayk, raghbatan warahbatan ilayk, la maljaa wala manja minka illa ilayk, amantu bikitabikal-lathee anzalt, wabinabiyyikal-lathee arsalt.)

1.translation: (Tanuu bɛɛ fɔ Alla mo hokkii an ɲaŋo ɓaawo o ittii o e an, O la ko ummugoo.)
1.instruction: (Alhamdu lillahil-lathee ahyana baAAda ma amatana wa-ilayhin-nushoor.)

2.translation: (Moolu te suutee moo la fo Alla ye, A kelenŋo alaa mɔɔ A seesaani, A ye laafitalaa nin tanuu bɛɛ, A se bɛɛ la tiinɗo. Alla meeñaani, tanuu bɛɛ fɔ Alla la, moolu te suutee moo la fo Alla ye, Alla bɛlaa, alaa sekaa walla fange so e Alla Sanŋalaa, Bɛlaa. E n Maraa yaafara n)
2.instruction: (La ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shay-in qadeer, subhanal-lah, walhamdu lillah, wala  ilaha illal-lah wallahu akbar, wala hawla wala quwwata illa billahil-AAaliyyil AAatheem. Rabbigh-fir lee)

3.translation: (Tanuu bɛɛ fɔ Alla mo ruttinii n weltal n la, ruttinii n neɗɗaagal n la, suutii n siinoo O la.)
3.instruction: (Alhamdu lillahil-lathee AAafanee fee jasadee waradda AAalayya roohee wa-athina lee bithikrih.)

4.instruction: Fuɗɗo Aaya 3:190 haa joofi surat Al-Imran

10.translation: ((Alla taa la). Alla, n dɔŋ I la jumaŋo bɛɛ nin jumaŋo waɗɓe la.)
10.instruction: ((Bismil-lah) allahumma innee aAAoothu bika minal-khubthi wal-khaba-ith.)

13.translation: (N seere moolu te suutee moo la fo Alla ye, A kelenŋo alaa mɔɔ A seesaani, n seere Muhammad le mu A baaroo nin A Kɛmɛ.)
13.instruction: (Ashhadu an la ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, wa-ashhadu anna Muhammadan AAabduhu warasooluh.)

14.translation: (Alla, waɗ n e u ruttitoo I la heewde e tobubugoo, waɗ n e u dooɗɗe ciilɓe laaɓɓe.)

15.translation: (I meeñaani Alla, n tantana I, n seere moolu te suutee moo la fo I ye, n I yaafaraa ɲini, n ruttoto I la tobubugoo la.)
15.instruction: (Subhanakal-lahumma wabihamdika ashhadu an la ilaha illa anta astaghfiruka wa-atoobu ilayk.)

16.translation: (Alla taa la, n dɔŋ Alla kan, alaa sekaa walla fange so e Alla.)
16.instruction: (Bismil-lah, tawakkaltu AAalal-lah, wala hawla wala quwwata illa billah.)

17.translation: (Alla, n dɔŋ I la mi waylaa walla waylaamaa, mi dusoo walla dusaamaa, mi tooñoo walla tooñoomaa, mi waɗoo faafoo walla faafoo waɗaa n la.)(dusoo: ko woni hakkee waɗoo alaa miijoo)
17.instruction: (Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika an adilla aw odal, aw azilla aw ozall, aw athlima aw othlam, aw ajhala aw yujhala AAalay.)

18.translation: (Alla taa la an naati, Alla taa la an yalti, an Maraa kan an dɔŋ.)
18.instruction: (Bismil-lahi walajna, wabismil-lahi kharajna, waAAala rabbina tawakkalna.)

19.translation: 'Alla, I ka yelenyaa kɛ n hakiloo la; I ka yelenyaa kɛ n kan la; I ka yelenyaa kɛ n tulooji la; I ka yelenyaa kɛ n ɲaaji la; I ka yelenyaa kɛ n sanŋa; I ka yelenyaa kɛ n jukoo; I ka yelenyaa kɛ n kininaa; I ka yelenyaa kɛ n cɛmanaa; I ka yelenyaa kɛ n kan; I ka yelenyaa kɛ n kɔŋo; I ka yelenyaa kɛ n neɗɗaagal la; I ka n yelenyaa ɲɛɛ; I ka n yelenyaa bonyaa; I ka n yelenyaa ani kɛ n yelenyaa. Alla, I ka n yelenyaa; I ka yelenyaa kɛ n jaaŋooji la; I ka yelenyaa kɛ n subuluu la; I ka yelenyaa kɛ n jolii la; I ka yelenyaa kɛ n suule la; I ka yelenyaa kɛ n faraa la.' [Alla, I ka yelenyaa kɛ n saamaa la nin yelenyaa kɛ n mɔɔkooji la]. [Ani I ka n ɲɛɛ yelenyaa ani I ka n ɲɛɛ yelenyaa ani I ka n ɲɛɛ yelenyaa]. [Ani I ka n yelenyaa kan yelenyaa kan.]'
19.instruction: Allaahummaj 'al fee qalbee nooran, wa fee lisaanee nooran, wa fee sam'ee nooran, wa fee basaree nooran, wa min fawqee nooran, wa min tahtee nooran, wa 'an yameenee nooran, wa 'an shimaalee nooran, wa min 'amaamee nooran, wa min khalfee nooran. Wa j'al fee nafsee nooran, wa 'a'dhim lee nooran, wa 'a'dhim lee nooran. Waj'al lee nooran, waj'alnee nooran. Allaahumma a'tineje nooran, waj'al fee 'asabee nooran, wa fee lahmee nooran, wa fee damee nooran, wa fee sha'ree nooran, wa fee basharee nooran.[Allaahummaj'al lee nooran fee qabree, wa nooran fee 'idhaamee.][Wa zidnee nooran, wa zidnee nooran, wa zidnee nooran.][Wa hab lee nooran 'alaa noor.]

20.translation: (N dɔŋ Alla Sanŋalaa nin A ɲiina teddungal nin A laamu ɓennundu e seytaan riiwaaɗo la. Alla taa la, salaat nin jam dow Nelaaɗo Alla. Alla, uddina n dammuguɗi hinɛ Ma.)
20.instruction: (aAAoothu billahil-AAatheem wabiwajhihil-kareem wasultanihil-qadeem minash-shaytanir-rajeem, [bismil-lah, wassalatu] [wassalamu AAala rasoolil-lah] , allahumma iftah lee abwaba rahmatik.)

21.translation: (Alla taa la, salaat nin jam dow Nelaaɗo Alla. Alla, n I ɲini e moƴƴe Ma. Alla, reen n e seytaan riiwaaɗo la.)
21.instruction: (Bismil-lah wassalatu wassalamu AAala rasoolil-lah, allahumma innee as-aluka min fadlik, allahumma iAAsimnee minash-shaytanir-rajeem.)

22.translation: 'Moo dendantoo no mu-aththin (moo noddaangol salaat) wiyi, fo so o wiyi: Hayya AAalas-salah (walla) hayya AAalal-falah 'ar salaat la, ar yaljere la' ɓaawo o, moo wiyu: La hawla wala quwwata illa billah. 'Alaa sekaa walla fange so e Alla.'

23.translation: Ɓaawo o laadamin konngol mu-aththin noddi, moo wiyi:'N fanan seere moolu te suutee moo la fo Alla ye, A kelenŋo, alaa mɔɔ A seesaani, Muhammad le mu A baaroo nin A Kɛmɛ. N jaɓi Alla Maraa la, Muhammad Kɛmɛ la, Lislaam deenoo la.'
23.instruction: Immediately following the declaration of faith called by the mu-aththin, one says:Wa-ana ashhadu an la ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, wa-anna Muhammadan AAabduhu warasooluh, radeetu billahi rabban wabimuhammadin rasoolan wabil-islami deena.

24.translation: 'Ɓaawo o moo nela salaat Nelaaɗo (Alla nela o salaat e jam) kan ɓaawo jaabugol noddaal mu.adhdhin'.

25.translation: 'Alla, Joom noddaal timmuɗo ŋoo, Joom salaat ŋoo keweteengoo, hokku Muhammad al-waseelah nin al-fadeelah, nela o dow nokku tanaaɗo min I ɓoɗɗii o. Tigi, I haɗaa I ɓoɗɗal.'al-waseelah: nokku Jannat.al-fadeelah: daraja sanŋa daadaa goɗɗe.nokku tanaaɗo: nokku min daadaa bɛɛ tantana o kan, ɓaddi hisaabe yaawde, wuttude e darrugol juutngol walla gollal yeewtugol.
25.instruction: Allahumma rabba hathihid-daAAwatit-tammah, wassalatil-qa-imah ati Muhammadan alwaseelata wal-fadeelah, wabAAath-hu maqaman mahmoodan allathee waAAadtah, innaka la tukhliful-meeAAad.

26.translation: Moo foti kadi ɗu'aa hoore mum e wakkati hakkunde adhaan nin iqamah sabu ɗu'aa wakkati ɗam haɗeteeɗaa.

5.translation: (Tanuu bɛɛ fɔ Alla mo suuti n e laɓɓe ŋoo, hokkii n o, alaa sekaa walla fange e mi.)
5.instruction: (Alhamdu lillahil-lathee kasanee hatha (aththawb) warazaqaneehi min ghayri hawlin minnee wala quwwah.)

6.translation: (Alla, tanuu bɛɛ ko Ma, I suuti n e o (ko woni laɓɓe), n I ɲini o moƴƴe nin moƴƴe o waɗaa, n dɔŋ I la o jumaŋo nin jumaŋo o waɗaa.)
6.instruction: (Allahumma lakal-hamdu anta kasawtaneeh, as-aluka min khayrihi wakhayri ma suniAAa lah, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharrihi washarri ma suniAAa lah.)

7.translation: (Maa I soo o juuti, Alla ta'ala lomtina o (e goɗɗo).' Maanaa yoɓi: ɗu'aa ɲaŋo juutngal.)

8.translation: (Soo keso, ɲaŋo tanaaɗo, saaya shaheed.)(shaheed:Mo saayi e kaɓgol kuffar kan si Alla laŋo toowtoo walla e kaldugol Lislaam. Jogori kadi miijooji goɗɗi e Sunnah no: mo saayi e kaldugol ɲaŋo mum, jawdi mum walla yimɓe mum; debbo maayi e jibinde; mo liɓi...nin tɔw.)

27.translation: (Alla, ɲɛnafoloo kɛ n nin n juŋooji cɛɛ cogo I kɛ tilebilaa nin tilebilaa cɛɛ, Alla, laaɓina n juŋooji cogo laɓɓe daneeje laaɓaa ɓaleejum, Alla, wusu n juŋooji mbuus, jii nin glaas la.)
27.instruction: (Allahumma baAAid baynee wabayna khatayaya kama baAAadta baynal-mashriqi walmaghrib, allahumma naqqinee min khatayaya kama yunaqqath-thawbul-abyadu minad-danas, allahummagh-silnee min khatayaya biththalji walma/i walbarad.)

28.translation: (I ye meeñaŋo Alla, n I tanuu. I tɔgɔ barika don, I yɔrɔ surun don, moolu te suutee moo la fo I ye.)
28.instruction: (Subhanakal-lahumma wabihamdika watabarakas-muka wataAAala jadduka wala ilaha ghayruk.)

29.translation: (N ye n ɲɛ jɛ tiɲɛ la O la min ye sanjiw ani dugukolo dan, n tɛ moolu boleeɓe la. Tiɲɛ na n sariya, n saraka, n ɲɛnamaya ani n saa ye Ala ye, adunaaruw Mara ye, a tɛ mɔɔ a la, o la n bɛ fee, n ye Musulmani kɔnɔ. Ala ye, I ye Mansa ye, moolu te suutee moo la fo I ye. I ye n ka Mara ye, n ye i jɔn ye, n ye n neɗaa yɛlɛ, n ye n juruya dɔnni, ka n yafa n juruya bɛɛ sabu moolu te juruya yafa fo I ye. I ka n ɲɛjira akhlaaq ɲuman juutii la sabu moolu tɛ a la ɲɛjira fo I ye, kana n yɛlɛ akhlaaq juguw la sabu moolu tɛ a la kana fo I ye. Mi ngoodi, e i noddaal jaaboo, sefere i gollinoo. Moƴƴew bɛɛ ye i bolo, juguw tɛ i na bɔ. N bɛ yen i miirde la, n bɛ i ta jukaraa. I barika don i surun don, n b'i yafaa ɲini n tubi i ma.)(Ala tɛ juguw laaɓŋo dan min te moƴƴe, nafa, xel walla hinɛ tɛ a kɔnɔ, a tɛ mɔɔ jaŋŋara hali a tɛ juruya kɛ. Fɛn bɛ se ka kɛ ɲuman a danni la i k'a lajɛ laawal do la, a bɛ juguw fana i k'a lajɛ laawal tɔ la. Ala ye setani dan, a kan a b'a jònw lajɛ, mɔɔw bɛ yen minnu tɛ setani kan, bɛ a ani a sira taabalo, bɛ laamu a ani a jokuluw kan, tɔw bɛ laamu setani kan bɛ a jinku jɔli. Juguw bɛ a danbagaw kɔnɔ a miirde ani a xel kan, a tɛ a baara walla a danni la.)
29.instruction: (Wajjahtu wajhiya lillathee fataras-samawati wal-arda haneefan wama ana minal-mushrikeen, inna salatee wanusukee wamahyaya wamamatee lillahi rabbil-AAalameen, la shareeka lahu wabithalika omirtu wa-ana minal-muslimeen. Allahumma antal-maliku la ilaha illa ant. anta rabbee wa-ana AAabduk, thalamtu nafsee waAAtaraftu bithanbee faghfir lee thunoobee jameeAAan innahu la yaghfiruth-thunooba illa ant.wahdinee li-ahsanil-akhlaqi la yahdee li-ahsaniha illa ant, wasrif AAannee sayyi-aha la yasrifu AAannee sayyi-aha illa ant, labbayka wasaAAdayk,walkhayru kulluhu biyadayk, washsharru laysa ilayk, ana bika wa-ilayk, tabarakta wataAAalayt, astaghfiruka wa-atoobu ilayk.)

30.translation: (Ala ye, Jibra-eel, Meeka-eel ani Israfeel (malaa'ika baw) Mara, sanjiw ani dugukolo Dan, muur ani ɲɛ Don. I de ye tansiri ye i jɔnw cɛ min na u y'a tiɲɛ. I ka n ɲɛjira tiɲɛ la i suutoo la, min na u y'a tiɲɛ, tigi i bɛ mɔɔ min ɲɛjira sira tilennen ma i b'a feera.)
30.instruction: (Allahumma rabba jibra-eel, wameeka-eel, wa-israfeel fatiras-samawati walard, AAalimal-ghaybi washshahadah, anta tahkumu bayna AAibadika feema kanoo feehi yakhtalifoon. ihdinee limakh-tulifa feehi minal-haqqi bi-ithnik, innaka tahdee man tasha-o ila siratin mustaqeem.)

31.translation: (Ala bɛlaa, Ala bɛlaa, Ala bɛlaa, tanuu ca ye Ala ye, tanuu ca ye Ala ye, tanuu ca ye Ala ye, n b'Ala meeñu fɔ sɔɔŋo ani suunoo.)(N dɔŋ Ala la setani la, a kaaɓoo, a jimoo ani a welwelo la.)
31.instruction: (Allahu akbaru kabeera, Allahu akbaru kabeera, Allahu akbaru kabeera, walhamdu lillahi katheera, walhamdu lillahi katheera, walhamdu lillahi katheera, wasubhanal-lahi bukratan wa-aseela.)(aAAoothu billahi minash-shaytani min nafkhihi wanafthihi wahamzih.)

32.translation: (Ala ye, tanuu bɛɛ ye i ye, i ye sanjiw ani dugukolo ani min bɛɛ u kɔnɔ Yeelenya ye. Tanuu bɛɛ ye i ye, i ye sanjiw ani dugukolo ani min bɛɛ u kɔnɔ Taama-kɛ baga ye. Tanuu bɛɛ ye i ye. I ye sanjiw ani dugukolo ani min bɛɛ u kɔnɔ Mara ye. Tanuu bɛɛ ye i ye ani sanjiw ani dugukolo ani min bɛɛ u kɔnɔ mara. Tanuu bɛɛ ye i ye, i ye sanjiw ani dugukolo Mansa ye, tanuu bɛɛ ye i ye. I ye Tiɲɛ ye, i dɛsɛ tiɲɛ don, i Kuma tiɲɛ don, Don min na an bɛ'i ye o tiɲɛ don, alijanna tiɲɛ don, tasuma tiɲɛ don, Nabiyaw tiɲɛ don, Muhammadu tiɲɛ don, Waati banba tiɲɛ don. Ala ye, n ka n di i ma, n bɛ kan kan i la, n b'i laadamini, n b'i kan tubi, n y'a tiɲɛ i kan, n y'a jate kɛ i fɛ. Ka n yafa juruya minnu kɛra ani minnu bɛɛ kɛ, min n muura ani min n kɛra ɲɛ na. I ye Al-Muqaddim ani Al-Mu-akhkhir ye. Moolu te suutee moo la fo I ye, i de ye n ka Furu ye, moolu te suutee moo la fo I ye.)(Al-Muqaddim ani Al-Mu-akhkhir kɔrɔ: Ala bɛ mɔɔ min ɲɛjira ani ka a nafa kɛ a danbagaw la i b'a feera, ni a bɛ mɔɔ min yɔpɔ ani ka a jokkiri i b'a feera a xel kan. Misali: mɔɔ nafa kɛ danbaga tɔw san, Nabiyaw nafa kɛ mɔɔ tɔw san, Muhammadu nafa kɛ Nabiyaw ani Kɛmɛw bɛɛ san…ani tɔw.)
32.instruction: (Allahumma lakal-hamd anta noorus-samawati wal-ardi waman feehin, walakal-hamd, anta qayyimus-samawati walardi waman feehin, [walakal-hamd, anta rabbus-samawati walardi waman feehin], [walakal-hamd, laka mulkus-samawati walardi waman feehin] [walakal-hamd, anta malikus-samawati walard] [walakal-hamd] [antal-haq, wawaAAdukal-haq, waqawlukal-haq, waliqa-okal-haq, waljannatu haq wannaru haq, wannabiyyoona haq, wa Muhammadun  haq, wassaAAatu haq] [allahumma laka aslamt, waAAalayka tawakkalt, wabika amant, wa-ilayka anabt, wabika khasamt, wa-ilayka hakamt, faghfir lee ma qaddamt, wama akhkhart, wama asrart, wama aAAlant] [antal-muqaddim, wa-antal-mu-akhkhir, la ilaha illa ant] [anta ilahee la ilaha illa ant .)

34.translation: (I meeñaani Ala, an Maraa, n I tanuu. Ala, yafara n.)

35.translation: (Laaɓoo ani Niimo (A le), malaa'ikaw Maraa ani Roohu (i.e. Jibra-eel).)

36.translation: (Ala, I la n raaji, I la n laadamini, I la n hokkii hoore. N menno, n ɲaahaa, n xel, n yewo, n dombo ani fɛn min n setaa lew, u teewii I la.)
36.instruction: (Allahumma laka rakaAAt, wabika amant, walaka aslamt, khashaAAa laka samAAee, wabasaree, wamukhkhee, waAAathmee, waAAasabee, wamas-taqalla bihi qadamee.)

37.translation: (A meeñaani, Kaŋoo se bɛɛ, laamu, kaaɓoo ani bɛluŋo.)

38.translation: (Alla jaabaaraa mo tantanaa A.)(Du'aa nin kɛa so a wuli.)

39.translation: (An Maraa, I ye tanuu bɛɛ ye, tanuu jɛlen ɲuman barikaman.)
39.instruction: (Rabbana walakal-hamdu hamdan katheeran tayyiban mubarakan feeh.)

40.translation: (Soomu jamalu nin leydi nin bɛɛ hakkunde ŋo bɛɛ siiti I tanuu la, nin bɛɛ I miirina siiti I tanuu la. Tanuu ani bɛluŋo Jogoo, tiɲɛtaa kuma baaɗo wiyi (I la) an bɛɛ ye I baaroolu. Ala, moolu te danna min I miirina hokki, moolu te hokki min I miirina danna, jawdi walla bɛluŋo nafaa moo, I la ko jawdi nin bɛluŋo bɛɛ.)(Du'aa nin kɛa duulaŋoo e koŋo o e kanŋa.)
40.instruction: (Mil-as-samawati wamil-al-ard, wama baynahuma, wamil/a ma shi/ta min shay-in baAAd, ahlath-thana-i walmajd, ahaqqu ma qalal-AAabd, wakulluna laka AAabd. Allahumma la maniAAa lima aAAtayt, wala muAAtiya lima manaAAt, wala yanfaAAu thal-jaddi minkal-jad.)

42.translation: (I meeñaani Ala, an Maraa, n I tanuu. Ala, yafara n.)

43.translation: (Laaɓoo ani Niimo (A le), malaa'ikaw Maraa ani Roohu (i.e. Jibra-eel).)

44.translation: (Ala, I la n sujud, I la n laadamini, I la n hokkii hoore. N ɲiina sujud O la min a daani, a jasooni, a bɔtini a menno nin a ɲaahaa. Ala barika, Dantoo ɲuman juutii.)
44.instruction: (Allahumma laka sajadt, wabika amant, walaka aslamt, sajada wajhee lillathee khalaqahu wasawwarahu washaqqa samAAahu wabasarahu, tabarakal-lahu ahsanul-khaliqeen.)

45.translation: (A meeñaani, Kaŋoo se bɛɛ, laamu, kaaɓoo ani bɛluŋo.)

46.translation: (Ala, yafara n juŋooji bɛɛ, fitininji nin mawji, juutii u fukkoo nin u kɔfɛ, bayyinoo nin suuɗoo.)
46.instruction: (Allahummagh-fir lee thanbee kullah, diqqahu wajillah, wa-awwalahu wa-akhirah, wa- AAalaniyyatahu wa-sirrah.)

47.translation: (Ala, n dɔŋ I tanɗaŋo la e I tanɗaŋoo, I yafaa la e I jaŋŋaralaa, n dɔŋ I la e I. N te waaya I tanuu limi, I le mu no I tantani hoore.)
47.instruction: (Allahumma innee aAAoothu biridaka min sakhatik, wa-bimuAAafatika min AAuqoobatik, wa-aAAoothu bika mink, la ohsee thana-an AAalayk, anta kama athnayta AAala nafsik.)

48.translation: (N Maraa yafara n, n Maraa yafara n.)

49.translation: (Ala, yafara n, hinɛ kɛ n ma, fewin n, richo n, tandoo n, rizqino n, ɓaɓɓoo n darajaa.)
49.instruction: (Allahummagh-fir lee, warhamnee, wahdinee, wajburnee, waAAafinee, warzuqnee warfaAAnee.)

50.translation: (N ɲiina sujud O la min a daani, a bɔtini a menno nin a ɲaahaa e A se nin A semmbe.<< Ala barika, Dantoo ɲuman juutii.)
50.instruction: (Sajada wajhee lillathee khalaqahu washaqqa samAAahu wabasarahu bihawlihi waquwwatih  { tabaraka Allahu ahsanu alkhaliqeen}.)

51.translation: (Ala, sikkina n sooro e o (sujud), wulu n juŋoo. Aanoo n a kɔfɛ, jaabaaraa a e n no I jaabaarii a e I baaroo Dawood.)
51.instruction: (Allahummak-tub lee biha  AAindaka ajra, wadaAA  AAannee biha wizra, wajAAalha lee AAindaka thukhra, wataqabbalha minnee kama taqabbaltaha min AAabdika Dawood.)

52.translation: (At-tahiyyat fɔ Alla la. Baara moolu nin u moƴƴi bɛɛ fɔ A la. Saafee nin Alla hinɛ nin A barikaaji I kan Nelaa. Saafee an kan nin Alla baaroolu goongaani bɛɛ kan. N shahaadaa moolu te suutee moo la fo Alla, n shahaadaa Muhammad le mu A baaroo nin A Kɛmɛ.)(At-tahiyyat: kumaaji bɛɛ u wiita Alla mawoolu. A abadoo woodugoo, A meeñugoo nin A laamu.)
52.instruction: (Attahiyyatu lillahi wassalawatu wattayyibat, assalamu AAalayka ayyuhan-nabiyyu warahmatul-lahi wabarakatuh, assalamu AAalayna waAAala AAibadil-lahis-saliheen. Ash-hadu an la ilaha illal-lah, wa-ashhadu anna Muhammadan AAabduhu warasooluh.)

53.translation: (Ala, salaa Muhammad kan nin Muhammad jokkuɓe kan, no I salii Ibraheem kan nin Ibraheem jokkuɓe kan. Tigi I le mu Tanuu-juutoo ani Bɛluŋo. Ala, barkoo Muhammad kan nin Muhammad yimɓe kan, no I barkii Ibraheem kan nin Ibraheem yimɓe kan. Tigi I le mu Tanuu-juutoo ani Bɛluŋo.)(salaa: tantana a, toownoo a e yuɓɓiree sanŋalaa bɛɛ juutii: malaa'ikaw u ɓurnoo ɓadi Alla yuɓɓiree.)((al) kɛrɛnginnaa maanaa yawtaree la: xeerɓe miijoo e maanaa ɗooɓoo ɓurnoo yiɗoo: a jokkuɓe nder a yimɓe.)
53.instruction: (Allahumma salli AAala Muhammad, wa-AAala ali Muhammad, kama sallayta AAala Ibraheema wa-AAala ali Ibraheem, innaka Hameedun Majeed, allahumma barik AAala  Muhammad, wa-AAala ali Muhammad, kama barakta AAala Ibraheema wa-AAala ali Ibraheem, innaka Hameedun Majeed.)

54.translation: (Ala, salaa Muhammad kan, a musooji nin a kooli kan, no I salii Ibraheem yimɓe kan, barkoo Muhammad kan, a musooji nin a kooli kan, no I barkii Ibraheem yimɓe kan. Tigi I le mu Tanuu-juutoo ani Bɛluŋo.)
54.instruction: (Allahumma salli AAala Muhammad wa-AAala azwajihi wathurriyyatihi kama sallayta AAala ali Ibraheem, wabarik AAala Muhammad, wa-AAala azwajihi wathurriyyatih, kama barakta AAala ali Ibraheem. innaka Hameedun Majeed.)

55.translation: (Ala, n dɔŋ I la e maanaŋ jaŋŋaralaa, e Jasiika jaŋŋaralaa, e ɲaŋo nin saayaa fitinooji, e Al-Maseeh Ad-Dajjal jumaŋo fitinoo.)(Al-Maseeh Ad-Dajjal: nder maandeeji mawɗi Wakkati Cakkitiingol nin fitinooji sanŋa mawɗi u ɓaddata moolu, Nelaa koo ɓaɓɓitini e mum. Moolu ɓurɓe ɓaddata a jokkoo. A feeñira Asbahan, Iran so Muslimɓe maa Qusṭanṭiniya jaami. A hokkirata semmbe ceeɓoo, a waɗata goonga yeewa no naa-goonga, naa-goonga no goonga. A miijata hoore goongaano, kɔfɛ a miijata nelaaŋo, cakkitiiŋoo mawoo. A maandeeji: a ɲaahaa ñaamere ɓaddata, o ko seedee tiɲɛ min jabbaa a miijoo hoore Alla, sabu o maandee alaa-meeñugoo. Kuma Kafir binndoo da hakkunde a ɲaahaaɗi, laadamintoo bee, binndoowo walla mo binndaa, bɛɛ anndoo.)
55.instruction: (Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika min AAathabil-qabr, wamin AAathabi jahannam, wamin fitnatil-mahya walmamat, wamin shari fitnatil-maseehid-dajjal.)

56.translation: (Ala, n dɔŋ I la e maanaŋ jaŋŋaralaa, n dɔŋ I la e Al-Maseeh Ad-Dajjal fewino nin fitinoo, n dɔŋ I la e ɲaŋo nin saayaa fitinooji. Ala, n dɔŋ I la e juŋoo nin banŋoo.)
56.instruction: (Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika min AAathabil-qabr, wa-aAAoothu bika min fitnatil-maseehid-dajjal, wa-aAAoothu bika min fitnatil-mahya walmamat. Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika minal-ma/thami walmaghram.)

57.translation: (Ala, n tooñi n neɗɗaagal tooñoo ɗuuɗɗoo, moolu te yaafara juŋoo fo I ye, yaafara n yafaa min I la, hinɛ kɛ n ma. Tigi I le mu Yaafaree-juutoo, Yiurndee-juutoo.)(Min I la: i.e. e I hinɛ yaŋgoo alaa n foti a, yafaa fotoo I nafaa kaaɓoo.)
57.instruction: (Allahumma innee thalamtu nafsee thulman katheeran wala yaghfiruth-thunooba illa ant, faghfir lee maghfiratan min AAindik warhamnee, innaka antal-Ghafoorur-Raheem.)

58.translation: (Ala, yafara n juŋooji u kɛni nin u arata, u n kɛni e suuɗoo nin u n bayyini, u n jaatii jiŋooji, nin u I anndu ɓuri n. I le mu Al-Muqaddim nin Al-Mu-akhkhir. Moolu te suutee moo la fo I ye.)(Maanaa Al-Muqaddim nin Al-Mu-akhkhir: Ala ɓaɓɓoo kan, nafaa kɛ mo O yiɗi e A daadaa nder, no O ɓaawtinaa, jokkiira mo O yiɗi e A xel kan. Misali: nafaa kɛ mɔɔ e daadaa tɔw san, nafaa kɛ Nelaaɓe e mɔɔ tɔw san, nafaa kɛ Muhammad e Nelaaɓe nin Kɛmɛɓe bɛɛ san...nin tɔw.)
58.instruction: (Allahummagh-fir lee ma qaddamtu,  wama akhkhart, wama asrartu wama aAAlant, wama asraftt, wama anta aAAlamu bihi minnee, antal-muqaddimu wa-antal-mu-akhkhiru la ilaha illa ant.)

59.translation: (Ala, walloo n e I mooftiiraa, I juŋaŋaaroo, I baaroo moƴƴoo la.)
59.instruction: (Allahumma aAAinnee AAala thikrik, washukrik, wahusni AAibadatik.)

60.translation: (Ala, n dɔŋ I la e mboloo nin saayakoo, n dɔŋ I la kana n artiraa ɓurngol bonde ɲaŋo "i.e. maaŋoolu, laaɓoo, alaa-sembe nin kuloo woodugoo", n dɔŋ I la e duniyaa fitinooji nin maanaŋ jaŋŋaralaa.)
60.instruction: (Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika minal-bukhl, wa-aAAoothu bika minal-jubn, wa-aAAoothu bika min an oradda ila arthalil- AAumur, wa-aAAoothu bika min fitnatid-dunya waAAathabil-qabr.)

61.translation: (Ala, n I ɲinoo I hokkoo n Jannat, n dɔŋ I la e Jasiika.)

62.translation: (Ala, e I anndee suuɗoo nin I se daadaa kan, ɲaŋoo n juutiŋo I anndinaa ɲaŋo ko moƴƴe n la, ɓoo n so I anndinaa saayaa ko ɓurnoo moƴƴe n la. Ala, waɗoo n kuloo I e suuɗoo nin bayyinoo, n I ɲinoo I waɗoo n goonga e kumoo, tanɗaŋo nin tanɗaŋoo sahaa. N I ɲinoo I waɗoo n hakkunde-woo e jawdi nin leeloo sahaa, n I ɲinoo I hokkoo n abadaa sewoo nin sefee min te kɔfɛ mooftii. N I ɲinoo I waɗoo n tanɗaa e ko I waɗii, nin ɲaŋo weecoo kɔfɛ saayaa. N I ɲinoo I Ñaahaa ŋaahaa sukkuree nin miiraa anjonku I la, e sira min te yiinoŋo naasii waddaa walla fitinoo jalloo. Ala, jasoo an e laadamoo koomoo, waɗoo an e u fewinoo nin fewinooɓe.)
62.instruction: (Allahumma biAAilmikal-ghayb, waqudratika AAalal-khalq, ahyinee ma AAalimtal-hayata khayran lee watawaffanee itha AAalimtal-wafata khayran lee, allahumma innee as-aluka khashyataka fil-ghaybi washshahadah, wa-as-aluka kalimatal-haqqi fir-rida walghadab, wa-as-alukal-qasda fil-ghina walfaqr, wa-as-aluka naAAeeman la yanfad, wa-as-aluka qurrata AAaynin la tanqatiAA, wa-as-alukar-rida baAAdal-qada/, wa-as-aluka bardal-AAayshi baAAdal-mawt, wa-as-aluka laththatan-nathari ila wajhik, washshawqa ila liqa-ik fee ghayri darraa mudirrah, wala fitnatin mudillah, allahumma zayyinna bizeenatil-eeman wajAAalna hudatan muhtadeen.)

63.translation: (Ala, n I ɲinoo Ala, I le mu Goɗɗoo, Tootooŋo, AS-Samad, O jibinaa, O jibinaa moo, moolu te suutee no A, I yaafara n n juŋooji sabu tigi I le mu Yaafaree-juutoo, Yiurndee-juutoo.)(AS-Samad: Hoore-hokkintoo Maraa, u meeñi juutii Jogoo min daadaa bɛɛ yeewa e jijooji bɛɛ la.)
63.instruction: (Allahumma innee as-aluka ya Allah bi-annakal-wahidul-ahadus-samad, allathee lam yalid walam yoolad, walam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad, an taghfira lee thunoobee innaka antal-Ghafoorur-Raheem.)

64.translation: (Ala, n I ɲinoo sabu I ye tanuu bɛɛ ye, moolu te suutee moo la fo I ye, I tokoo, alaa mɔɔ. I le mu Nafaa-kɛtala. Daadoo soomu jamalu nin leydi, Bɛluŋo ani Sanŋoo Jogoo, Aɲaŋoo-taa, Hoore-taayaa ani Fow Taamintoo, tigi n I ɲinoo I hokkoo n Jannat, n dɔŋ I la e Jasiika.)
64.instruction: (Allahumma innee as-aluka bianna lakal-hamd, la ilaha illa ant wahdaka la shareeka lak, almannan, ya badeeAAas-samawati wal-ard, ya thal-jalali wal-ikram, ya hayyu ya qayyoom, innee as-alukal-jannah, wa-aAAoothu bika minan-nar.)

65.translation: (Ala, n I ɲinoo, sabu n shahaadaa I le mu Alla, moolu te suutee moo la fo I ye, Goɗɗoo, AS-Samad min jibinaa, min jibinaa moo, moolu te suutee no A.)(AS-Samad: Hoore-hokkintoo Maraa, u meeñi juutii Jogoo min daadaa bɛɛ yeewa e jijooji bɛɛ la.)
65.instruction: (Allahumma inne as-aluka biannee ashhadu annaka antal-lah, la ilaha illa ant, al-ahadus-samad, allathee lam yalid walam yoolad walam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad.)

66.translation: (N Alla yaafaa ɲinoo.(saboo) (Ala, I le mu As-Salam, I la ko saafee bɛɛ, I barika, Bɛluŋo ani Sanŋoo Jogoo.) (As-Salam: O fisaani koo nin jiloo koo la.))
66.instruction: (Astaghfirul-lah (three times) (Allahumma antas-salam waminkas-salam, tabarakta ya thal-jalali wal-ikram.))

67.translation: (Moolu te suutee moo la fo Alla, A tokoo, alaa mɔɔ, A le mu laamu nin tanuu, A bɛ se fɛn bɛɛ la. Ala, moolu te danna min I miirina hokki, moolu te hokki min I miirina danna, jawdi walla bɛluŋo nafaa moo, I la ko jawdi nin bɛluŋo bɛɛ.)
67.instruction: (La ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeer, allahumma la maniAAa lima aAAtayt, wala muAAtiya lima manaAAt, wala yanfaAAu thal-jaddi minkal-jad.)

68.translation: (Moolu te suutee moo la fo Alla, A tokoo, alaa mɔɔ, A le mu laamu nin tanuu, A bɛ se fɛn bɛɛ la. Alaa sembe walla se fo e Alla la, moolu te suutee moo la fo Alla, an te suutee moo fo A. A le mu nafaa, hinɛ nin tanuu bɛluŋo bɛɛ. Moolu te suutee moo la fo Alla, an goonganee e laadamoo nin lafitaloo A la, hali kaafirɓe yiɗaa o.)
68.instruction: (La ilaha illal-lah, wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeer. la hawla wala quwwata illa billah, la ilaha illal-lah, wala naAAbudu illa iyyah, lahun-niAAmatu walahul-fadl walahuth-thana-ol- hasan, la ilaha illal-lah mukhliseena lahud-deen walaw karihal-kafiroon.)

69.translation: (Ala meeñaani, tanuu bɛɛ ye Ala ye, Ala ka ca koosɛbɛ.(biɲi saba nin saba kɔ) (Moolu te suutee moo la fo Ala, A tokoo, alaa mɔɔ, A le mu laamu nin tanuu, A bɛ se fɛn bɛɛ la.))
69.instruction: (Subhanal-lah walhamdu lillah, wallahu akbar (biɲi saba nin saba kɔ). (La ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeer.))

70.translation: Soorah saba ninnu kaa kɛ kelen Zuhr, 'Asr nin 'Ishaa sariya kɔfɛ, saba kɔ Fajr nin Maghrib sariya kɔfɛ.[Soorah al-Ikhlaas (112)] [Soorah al-Falaq (113)] [Soorah an-Naas (114)]

71.translation: A ye Sunnah kɔnɔ fana ka Aayat ul-Kursee kɛ sariya o sariya kɔfɛ:[Soorah al-Baqarah, Aayah 255]

72.translation: (Moolu te suutee moo la fo Ala, A tokoo, alaa mɔɔ, A le mu laamu nin tanuu, A bɛ ɲaŋo hokki, A bɛ saa hokki, A bɛ se fɛn bɛɛ la.(biɲi tan maghrib nin fajr sariya kɔfɛ))
72.instruction: (La ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, yuhyee wayumeet, wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeer.(ten times after the maghrib & fajr prayers))

73.translation: (Ala, n I ɲinoo I hokkoo n dɔnniya nafaa, rizqi diɲɛ, baara jaabaa.)(Kaa wiya salam kɔfɛ fajr sariya la)
73.instruction: (Allahumma innee as-aluka AAilman nafiAAan, warizqan tayyiban, waAAamalan mutaqabbalan.(salam kɔfɛ fajr sariya la))

74.translation: (Jabir Ibn AAabdullah ma, a fɔ: 'Nelaa b'an kalan ka ɲɛjirali ɲini an ko bɛɛ la, cogo a b'an kalan sura Kurana la. A bɛ fɔ: 'N'i dɔ miirina ko bɛɛ, a ka sariya fila kɛ (fila rakAAah nafilah), o kɔfɛ a ka du'aa kɛ:'Ala ye, n b'i laamu ɲini i dɔnniya la, i se la n b'i semmbe ɲini, n b'i ɲini i nafaa baa fɛ, kɔn tiɲɛ na i bɛ se, n tɛ se, tiɲɛ na i don, n tɛ don, i ye Muur Anndoo juutii ye. Ala ye, n'i dɔn ko ko nin ye ɲuman ye n ma n diine, n ɲaŋo ani n banba kan, kɛ a cira ani a weecoo n ma, i ka a barika n na, n'i dɔn ko ko nin ye jumaŋo ye n ma n diine, n ɲaŋo ani n banba kan, bɔ a n na ani bɔ n a na, kɛ ɲuman min bɛ yen o yen cira n ma ani waɗoo n tanɗaa a la.)(Moo min ɲɛjirali ɲinoo a Dantoo fɛ ani ka a kelenbagaw kuma kɛ, o kɔfɛ a to a cira kan, a tɛ nɔgɔya, kɔn Ala y'a fɔ:…kuma kɛ u fɛ ko la. N'i y'a cira ta, i ka i kan kan Ala la…)
74.instruction: (Jabir Ibn AAabdullah ma, a fɔ: 'Nelaa b'an kalan ka ɲɛjirali ɲini an ko bɛɛ la, cogo a b'an kalan sura Kurana la. A bɛ fɔ: ' N'i dɔ miirina ko bɛɛ, a ka sariya fila kɛ (fila rakAAah nafilah), o kɔfɛ a ka du'aa kɛ:Allahumma innee astakheeruka biAAilmik, wa-astaqdiruka biqudratik, wa-as-aluka min fadlikal-AAatheem, fa-innaka taqdiru wala aqdir, wataAAlamu wala aAAlam ,wa-anta AAallamul ghuyoob, allahumma in kunta taAAlamu anna hathal-amr (say your need) khayrun lee fee deenee wamaAAashee waAAaqibati amree faqdurhu lee, wayassirhu lee, thumma barik lee feeh, wa-in kunta taAAlamu anna hathal-amr sharrun lee fee deenee wamaAAashee waAAaqibati amree fasrifhu AAannee wasrifnee AAanh, waqdur liyal-khayra haythu kan, thumma ardinee bih.)(One who seeks guidance from his Creator and consults his fellow believers and then remains firm in his resolve does not regret, for Allah has said:washawirhum fee al-amri fa-itha AAazamta fatawakkal AAala Allah)(chapter 3 verse 159)

112.translation: (Moolu te suutee moo la fo Ala, Goɗɗoo, AL-Qahhaar. Sanjiw ani dugukolo nin bɛɛ hakkunde ŋo Maraa, Semmbe-baa, Yaafaree-baa.)(AL-Qahhaar: O min y'a daadaa bɛɛ yɛrɛ, daadaa bɛɛ bɛ a kan. Taama bɛɛ bɛ a miirde la.)
112.instruction: (La ilaha illal-lahul-wahidul-qahhar, rabbus-samawati wama baynahuma, alAAazeezul-ghaffar.)

113.translation: (N dɔŋ Ala kuma dafalenw la a dimi nin a jaŋŋaralaa la, a baaroolu jumaŋo la, nin setaniw welwelo nin u bɔli la.)
113.instruction: (aAAoothu bikalimatil-lahit-tammat min ghadabih,waAAiqabih, washarri AAibadih, wamin hamazatish-shayateen, wa-an yahduroon.)

114.translation: [((Tu i cɛmana saba kɔ)(Tu: tu min bɛ moo fɛ ni jii dɔɔni)) - (Dɔŋ Ala la setani nin min i ɲaahi jumaŋo la (saba kɔ)) - (Kana a kuma moo si ma) - (Yɛlɛ ani sunɔgɔ fɛn tɔ kan min i y'a kan sunɔgɔ fukkoo.) - (Wuli ani sariya n'i b'a feera.) ]

116.translation: (Ala, fewin n e u I fewini, yafara n e u I yafari, wonloo n e u I wonloota, barkoo n e ko I hokkini. Kisii n e jumaŋo I waɗii sabu tigi I waɗoo, moolu te waɗoo I kan. Tiɲɛtɛŋo, mo I wonloota a te jiloo, mo I ɓoo a te sanŋoo ani bɛluŋo. An Maraa, I barika I sanŋa.)(Jumaŋo I waɗii: Ala tɛ jumaŋo laaɓŋo daani min te moƴƴe, nafa, xel walla hinɛ tɛ a kɔnɔ, a tɛ moo jaŋŋara hali a tɛ juŋoo kɛ. Fɛn bɛ se ka kɛ ɲuman a daanni la i k'a lajɛ laawal do la, a bɛ jumaŋo fana i k'a lajɛ laawal tɔ la. Ala ye setani daani, a kan a b'a baaroolu lajɛ, mɔɔw bɛ yen minnu yiɗaa setani, kaɓoo a nin a sira, ngoni ginoowo e a nin a jokkuɓe, tɔw bɛ laamu setani kan jokkuɓe a jinkuuji. Jumaŋo woodi A daadaa kɔnɔ e A miirde nin A xel, alaa e A baara walla A daanni la.)
116.instruction: (Allahummah-dinee feeman hadayt, waAAafinee feeman AAafayt, watawallanee feeman tawallayt, wabarik lee feema aAAtayt, waqinee sharra ma qadayt, fa-innaka taqdee wala yuqda AAalayk, innahu la yathillu man walayt, [wala yaAAizzu man AAadayt], tabarakta rabbana wataAAalayt.)

117.translation: (Ala, n dɔŋ I tanɗaŋo la e I tanɗaŋoo, I yafaa la e I jaŋŋaralaa, n dɔŋ I la e I. N te waaya I tanuu limi. I le mu no I tantani hoore.)
117.instruction: (Allahumma innee aAAoothu biridaka min sakhatik, wabimuAAafatika min AAuqoobatik, wa-aAAoothu bika mink, la ohsee thana-an AAalayk, anta kama athnayta AAala nafsik.)

118.translation: (Ala, I la an baaroo, I la an sariyoo nin sujud, I la an haaɗoo, I la an gollinoo. An hope I hinɛ, an kuloo I jaŋŋaralaa, tigi I jaŋŋaralaa ɓaddata kaafirɓe kan. Ala, an I walloo ɲinoo, an I yafaa ɲinoo, an I tantanaa e moƴƴe bɛɛ, an kaafiraa I la. An laadamini I la an hokkii hoore I la, an wuluu, yaaɓoo u kaafirii I la.)
118.instruction: (Allahumma iyyaka naAAbud, walaka nusallee wanasjud, wa-ilayka nasAAa wanahfid, narjoo rahmatak, wanakhsha AAathabak, inna AAathabaka bilkafireena mulhaq. Allahumma inna nastaAAeenuk, wanastaghfiruk, wanuthnee AAalaykal- khayr, wala nakfuruk, wanu/minu bik, wanakhdaAAu lak wanakhlaAAu man yakfuruk.)

119.translation: (Mansaa, Niimoo meeñaani.(saboo) sabooŋoo kɔŋoo, a wiliiririra a kumoo, juutoo a, ɓeydoo: (Malaa'ikaw Maraa nin Roohu (i.e. Jibra-eel).))
119.instruction: (Subhanal-malikil-quddoos.(saboo).sabooŋoo kɔŋoo, a wiliiririra a kumoo, juutoo a, ɓeydoo: (Rabbil-mala-ikati warrooh.))

120.translation: (Ala, n le mu I baaroo, I baaroo ɓii, I baaroodoo ɓii, n ɲiiŋoo I bolo (i.e. I se si n kan bɛɛ), I yamiroo n kan kɛraa abadaa, I waɗoo n kan ko ñiyaasa. N I ɲinoo e tɔgɔ koo I jogoo min I tɔgɔni hoore, walla I hollini e I Kitabu, walla I kalanini a e I daadaa do, walla I aanini e anndee suuɗoo I la, I waɗoo Kurana n xelu ɲaŋo nin n ɓeroo yelenyaa, n mooŋoo ɓaawtinirtee nin n hijoo wulirtee.)
120.instruction: (Allahumma innee AAabduk, ibnu AAabdik, ibnu amatik, nasiyatee biyadik, madin fiyya hukmuk, AAadlun fiyya qada-ok, as-aluka bikulli ismin huwa lak, sammayta bihi nafsak, aw anzaltahu fee kitabik, aw AAallamtahu ahadan min khalqik awis-ta/tharta bihi fee AAilmil-ghaybi AAindak, an tajAAalal-Qurana rabeeAAa qalbee, wanoora sadree, wajalaa huznee wathahaba hammee.)

121.translation: (Ala, n dɔŋ I la e gɛlɛya nin son, doole tɛ nin kaɲi, mboloo nin saayakoo, banŋoo juutoo nin mow yɛrɛ n kan la.)
121.instruction: (Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika minal-hammi walhuzn, walAAajzi walkasali walbukhli waljubn, wadalAAid-dayni waghalabatir-rijal.)

122.translation: (Moolu te suutee moo la fo Ala Muusoo-baa. Moolu te suutee moo la fo Ala, kursi baa Maraa. Moolu te suutee moo la fo Ala, sanjiw Maraa, dugukolo Maraa nin kursi noyaba Maraa.)
122.instruction: (La ilaha illal-lahul-AAatheemul-haleem, la ilaha illal-lahu rabbul-AAarshil-AAatheem, la ilaha illal-lahu  rabbus-samawati warabbul-ardi warabbul-AAarshil-kareem.)

123.translation: (Ala, I hinɛ la n bɛ ɓatoo, kana n to n yɛrɛ na fo ɲɛ dɛɛɛ fɛ, ɲɛjira kɛ n ko bɛɛ la. Moolu te suutee moo la fo I ye.)
123.instruction: (Allahumma rahmataka arjoo fala takilnee ila nafsee tarfata AAayn, wa-aslih lee sha/nee kullah, la ilaha illa ant.)

124.translation: (Moolu te suutee moo la fo I ye. I meeñaani, tiɲɛ na n wonnoo e tooñooɓe.)
124.instruction: (La ilaha illa anta subhanaka innee kuntu minath-thalimeen.)

125.translation: (Ala, Ala le mu n Maraa, n te fɛn si kɛ a ta la.)

126.translation: (Ala, an I to u ɲaaha ŋaaha, an dɔŋ I la e u jumaŋo.)
126.instruction: (Allahumma inna najAAaluka fee nuhoorihim wanaAAoothu bika min shuroorihim.)

127.translation: (Ala, I le mu n taamintoo, I le mu n wallooɗo, I la n yaaya, I la n ɓaddoo, I la n kaɓoo.)
127.instruction: (Allahumma anta AAadudee, wa-anta naseeree, bika ajoolu wabika asoolu wabika oqatil)

128.translation: (Ala fotoo an, aminaa-jogoo ɲuman jee (A le).)

129.translation: Ala, sanjiw jee-jee Maraa, Kursi Baa Maraa, wonloo n e [moo min tɔgɔ] nin a wallooɓe nder I daadaa, kana u do jumaŋoo n walla tooñoo n. Bɛlaŋo I taamintoo, sanŋalaa I tanuuji. Moolu te foti suutee fo I ye.
129.instruction: Allaahumma rabbas-samaawaatis-sab'i, wa Rabbal-'Arshil-'Adheem, Kun lee jaaran min (here you mention the person's name) wa 'ahzabihi min khalaa'iqika, 'an yafruta 'alayya 'ahadun minhum 'aw yatghaa,'Azza jaaruka, wa jalla thanaa'uka, wa laa 'ilaaha 'illaa 'Anta.

130.translation: Alla bɛlaa, Semmbee e A daadaa bɛɛ juutii. A Semmbee e ko n kuloo nin ko n hijoo. N dɔŋ Alla la, O moolu te foti suutee fo A ye, O le mu sanjiw jee-jee jaaɓoo ɓaddoo leydi kan fo e A yamiroo. [N dɔŋ I la Ala] e I baaroo [moo tɔgɔ] jumaŋo, a wallooɓe, a jokkuɓe nin a taamintooɓe nder jinn nin mow. Ala, wonloo n e u jumaŋo. Sanŋalaa I tanuuji, bɛlaŋo I taamintoo. I Tɔgɔ barika, moolu te Dewum goonga fo I ye. (Kɛ saba kɔ carab la)
130.instruction: Allaahu Akbar, Allaahu 'a'azzu min khalqihi jamee'an, Allaahu 'a'azzu mimmaa 'akhaafu wa 'ahdharu, 'a'oothu billaahil-lathee laa ilaaha illaa huwa, almumsikis-samaawaatis-sab'i 'an yaqa'na 'alaal-'ardhi 'illaa bi'ithnihi, min sharri 'abdika (name of the person) wa junoodihi wa 'atbaa'ihi wa ashyaa'ihi minal-jinni wal'insi, Allaahumma kun lee jaaran min sharrihim, Jalla thanaa'uka wa 'azza aaruka, wa tabaarakasmuka, wa laa ilaaha ghayruka.

131.translation: (Ala, Kitabu Yiridala, gaaw jate, sàcc bolokoloba. Ala, sàcc u ani tirisigi u.)

132.translation: (Ala, kɛnɛyali kɛ n ma u ma min I b'a feera.)

133.instruction: (Fɔ:) n bɛ kan kan Ala la. (O kɔfɛ i ka dabila min i b'a la diisoo.)

134.translation: (A ka fɔ: (N laadamini Ala nin a Kɛmɛ la.))

135.translation: (A ka fana aya ninnu kɛ: (A le mu Fukkoo nin Banbaa, Aththaahir nin Al-Baatin, A dɔnnii fɛn bɛɛ lool.)(Aththaahir: o hollitoo A u meeñi bonya nin daadaa kelen-kelen bɛɛ fitinoo A bonya nin A sanŋoo ɲɛ na, A le a daadaa bɛɛ san A mɛnni nin A u meeñi la.)(Al-Baatin: o hollitoo A dɔnnii muur bɛɛ, min bɛ xeluw kɔnɔ nin fɛn ɲaminɛw, no o hollitoo A ɓadi nin A ɓadi bɛɛ la e sira fotoo A bɛluŋo.))
135.instruction: (A ka fana aya ninnu kɛ: ( Huwa al-awwalu, waal-akhiru, waalththahiru waalbatinu wahuwa bikulli shayin AAaleem))

136.translation: (Ala, waɗoo halaal fotoo n e haraam, ɓarkoo n e I nafaa, kana n jiiɓoo mow tɔw.)
136.instruction: (Allahummak-finee bihalalika AAan haramik, wa-aghninee bifadlika AAamman siwak.)

137.translation: (Ala, n dɔŋ I la e gɛlɛya nin son, doole tɛ nin kaɲi, mboloo nin saayakoo, banŋoo juutoo nin mow yɛrɛ n kan la.)
137.instruction: (Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika minal-hammi walhuzn, walAAajzi walkasal, walbukhl, waljubn, wadalAAid-dayni waghalabatir-rijal)

138.translation: (Othman Ibn Al-AAas fii: n wiyi 'Alla Kɛmɛ, tigi seytaan ɓata hakkunde n nin n sariya nin n karoo, a ɓaloo n'. Alla Kɛmɛ jaabii 'Ɗum ko seytaan min tɔgɔtaa Khanzab, so I hijoo a woodugoo, dɔŋ Alla la e mum, tu (tu min bɛ moo fɛ ni jii dɔɔni) I cɛmana saba kɔ.)

139.translation: (Ala, weecoo alaa fo min I waɗini weecoo, I waɗoo gɛlɛyoo, so I miirina, weecoo.)
139.instruction: (Allahumma la sahla illa ma jaAAaltahu sahla, wa-anta tajAAalul- hazana in shi'ta sahla.)

140.translation: (Baaroo koo juŋoo kɛni, o kɔfɛ, a ɓoynii, a sariyaa fila (i.e. rakAAa fila), kɔfɛ a Alla yaafaa ɲinoo, Alla yaafaraa a.)

143.translation: (Kurana kalanni nin mooftiiraa nin ɲini sɛbɛw tiɲɛw.)(i k'a 'Kana i so kɛ yàqw cogo, tiɲɛ na setaniw bɛ sotti so min na soorat Al-Baqarah kalanna' Muslim kuma 1/539, fana ɲini nin mooftiiraa sɔɔŋo nin suunoo, sunɔgɔ ɲɛ na, wuli sahaa, soo don nin bɔ, misiri don nin bɔ, ayat Al-kursiyy kalanni nin aya fila banbaw soorat Al-Baqarah sunɔgɔ ɲɛ na, azan…nin tɔw.)

144.translation: (Ala y'a cira, min A b'a feera A b'a kɛ.)(kɔn tiɲɛ na 'N'a' bɛ setani baara don.)

145.translation: Ala ka i barika i nafaa min A y'i, i ka (ba kura) juŋaŋaaraa, den ka a waatiw se, i ka a goongaa hokkiri. Moo min ñu baaraa bɛ jaaboo: Ala ka i barika, A ka a barika i kan, Ala ka i sara ɲuman nin ka a kelenya i ma nin ka i sara ca.
145.instruction: Baarakallaahu laka fil-mawhoobi laka, wa shakartal-waahiba, wa balagha 'ashuddahu, wa ruzigta birrahu.  Moo min ñu baaraa bɛ jaaboo: Baarakallahu laka wa baaraka 'alayka, wa jazaakallaahu khayran, wa razaqakallaahu mithlahu, wa 'ajzala thawaabaka.

146.translation: (Ibn AAabbas fii ko Alla Kɛmɛ bɛ Al-Hasan nin Al-Husayn hokkoo Alla kisoo bolo, a bɛ wiyi:(N iɓe hokkoo Alla kuma dafalenw kisoo bolo e setani koo, fɛn-janoo koo, nin ɲaahaa jumaŋo koo.))
146.instruction: (Ibn AAabbas fii ko Alla Kɛmɛ bɛ Al-Hasan nin Al-Husayn hokkoo Alla kisoo bolo, a bɛ wiyi:(OAAeethukuma bikalimatil-lahit-tammah, min kulli shaytanin wahammah, wamin kulli AAaynin lammah.))

147.translation: (Ko tɛ, (banŋoo) ye laaɓoo kɛ, so Alla miirina.)

148.translation: (N Alla Sanŋalaa ɲinoo, kursi baa Maraa, a kɛnɛyoo I'.(biɲi jee-jee) ((banŋoo tala) kɛnɛyata.))

149.translation: (Ali Ibn Abee Talib fii ko a menno Alla Kɛmɛ bɛ wiyi: 'N moo kelen b'a muslim ɓalaaŋoo banŋoo tɔmɔtɔ kɛ, ko no a bɛ taama ka jannat sɛnsɛnw ɲini fo a joo, n'a joo, hinɛ bɛ a suya, n'a o sɔɔŋo ye, malaa'ikaw baara taŋan bɛ salaa a kan fo suunoo, n'a o suunoo ye, malaa'ikaw baara taŋan bɛ salaa a kan fo sɔɔŋo.)

150.translation: 'Ala, yafara n, hinɛ kɛ n ma, walloo n e u sanŋa mawɗe kondirtooɓe

151.translation: ('Aa.ishah (Ala ka a nɛɛ ɲi) kuma ne ko Nelaa (Ala ka a barika nin a hɛrɛ) [a banŋoo min na a saayi] bɛ a bolow sɔ jii na k'a nɛ fɔ k'a fɔ: 'Moolu te suutee moo la fo Ala, saayaa tigi gɛlɛyoo tɛ a kɔnɔ.'
151.instruction: 'Aa.ishah (radhi-yAllaahu 'anhaa) kuma ne ko Nelaa (sal-Allaahu 'alayhe wa sallam) [a banŋoo min na a saayi] bɛ a bolow sɔ jii na k'a nɛ fɔ k'a fɔ:[La ilaha illal-lah, inna lilmawti lasakarat.]

152.translation: (Moolu te suutee moo la fo Ala, Ala bɛlaa. Moolu te suutee moo la fo Ala, A tokoo. Moolu te suutee moo la fo Ala, A tokoo, alaa mɔɔ. Moolu te suutee moo la fo Ala, A le mu laamu nin tanuu. Moolu te suutee moo la fo Ala, sembe walla se alaa fo e Alla la.)
152.instruction: (La ilaha illal-lah, wallahu akbar, la ilaha illal-lahu wahdah, la shareeka lah, la ilaha illal-lahu lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, la ilaha illal-lah, wala hawla wala quwwata illa billah.)

153.translation: o kɔrɔ ko moo minw bɛ banŋoo tala ɓadi, u ka a lajɛ nin a ka a to ko a ka shahadah fɔ. (Moo min kuma banbaw bɛ: (Moolu te suutee moo la fo Ala.) a maa jannat don.)
153.instruction: o kɔrɔ ko moo minw bɛ banŋoo tala ɓadi, u ka a lajɛ nin a ka a to ko a ka shahadah fɔ. (Moo min kuma banbaw bɛ: (La ilaha illal-lah.) a maa jannat don.)

154.translation: (An le mu Alla jago, A la an ruttoto. Ala, saraa n e n yiinoŋo, lomtina a e ɓurngoo moƴƴe.)
154.instruction: (Inna lillahi wa-inna ilayhi rajiAAoon, allahumma/- jurnee fee museebatee wakhluf lee khayran minha.)

155.translation: (Ala, yafara -ɓaŋ tala tɔgɔ miiraa ɗoo- ɓaɓɓoo a darajaa nder u fewinooɓe, wonloo jaltintoo u a accini kɔfɛ, yafara an nin a, adunaaruuji Maraa. Yuɓɓoo a maanaŋ, yelenyoo a a la.)(Jaltintoo: moo jaltintoo goɗɗo sabu a alaa-woodugoo walla a saayaa. Ɗum le mu kuma khaleefah goonga maanaa; ko nde, goonga alaa laadamoo Adam le mu Alla khaleefah (lomtintoo, no o kɛrɛnginnaa baasoo) leydi kan sabu Alla alaa mooftii, A te saayoo mooftii. Du'aa nin seedoo maanaa goonga kuma nin, hollitoo Alla jaltintoo an, aanaa u an accii kɔfɛ so an saayi walla an alaa (lajɛ fana du'aa #198).)
155.instruction: (Allahummagh-fir li-name the dead- warfaAA darajatahu fil-mahdiyyeen, wakhlufhu fee AAaqibihi fil-ghabireen, waghfir lana walahu ya rabbal-AAalameen wafsah lahu fee qabrih, wanawwir lahu feeh.)

156.translation: (Ala, yafara a, hinɛ kɛ a ma, ɓaawtinoo a, fowtoo a, sanŋoo a jaaɓee. Yuɓɓoo a donoo, ɓoynoo a e jii, mbuus, nin glaas, ciiloo a e juŋoo no laɓɓe daneeje ciilaa ɓaleejum. Lomtina a soo e ɓurngoo moƴƴe soo, a yimɓe e ɓurngoo moƴƴe yimɓe, a musoo e ɓurngoo moƴƴe musoo. Donoo a Jannat, kisoo a e maanaŋ jaŋŋaralaa nin Jasiika jaŋŋaralaa.)
156.instruction: (Allahummagh-fir lahu warhamh, waAAafihi, waAAfu AAanh, wa-akrim nuzulah, wawassiAA mudkhalah, waghsilhu bilma-i waththalji walbarad, wanaqqihi minal-khataya kama naqqaytath-thawbal-abyada minad-danas, wa-abdilhu daran khayran min darih, wa-ahlan khayran min ahlih wazawjan khayran min zawjih, wa-adkhilhul-jannah, wa-aAAithhu min AAathabil-qabr, waAAathabin-nar)

157.translation: (Ala, yafara an ɲaŋooɓe nin an saayaaɓe, an woodiɓe nin an alaaɓe, an fitininji nin an mawji, an kori nin an musooji. Ala, mo an nder I ɲaŋini, waɗoo ɲaŋo kan Lislaam, mo an nder I ɓooni I la, waɗoo saayaa kan laadamoo. Ala, kana an leeloo e a sooro, kana an jalloo a kɔfɛ.)
157.instruction: (Allahummagh-fir lihayyina wamayyitina washahidina, wagha-ibina, wasagheerina wakabeerina, wathakarina wa-onthana. Allahumma man ahyaytahu minna fa-ahyihi AAalal-islam, waman tawaffaytahu minna fatawaffahu AAalal-eeman, allahumma la tahrimna ajrah, wala tudillana baAAdah.)

158.translation: (Ala, ko-ɓalaaŋoo I taamaloo nin I kisoo kɔnɔ, kisoo a e maanaŋ fitinoo nin Jasiika jaŋŋaralaa. Tigi I le mu aminaa nin goonga jogo. Yafara a, hinɛ kɛ a ma, tiɲɛ na I le mu Yaafaree-juutoo, Yiurndee-juutoo.)
158.instruction: (Allahumma inna -name the dead- fee thimmatik, wahabli jiwarik, faqihi min fitnatil-qabr waAAathabin-nar, wa-anta ahlul-wafa/, walhaq, faghfir lahu warhamh, innaka antal-ghafoorur-raheem.)

159.translation: (Ala, I baaroo nin I baaroodoo ɓii jiiɓii I hinɛ, I jiiɓaa a jaŋŋaralaa. So a wonnoo moƴƴoo-kɛtala, ɓeydoo a sooro, so a wonnoo jumaŋo-kɛtala, ɓaawtinoo a juŋooji.)
159.instruction: (Allahumma AAabduka wabnu amatik, ihtaja ila rahmatik, wa-anta ghaniyyun AAan AAathabih, in kana muhsinan fazid fee hasanatih, wa-in kana museean fatajawaz AAanh.)

160.translation: Ala, kisoo a e maanaŋ jaŋŋaralaa. [ko ɲuman fana wiyi] Ala, waɗoo a ɓaɓɓitoo, fewitoo nin aanoo a baaba nin a neene la, weecooɗo jaabaaraa. Ala, waɗoo a juutoo e u miinaaji (moƴƴe), mawoo u sooro. Waɗoo a walloo e laadamintooɓe goongaani. To a e Ibraheem taamaloo. Hisnoo a e I hinɛ e Jasiika jaŋŋaralaa. Hokkoo a soo ɓurngoo a soo moƴƴe, yimɓe ɓurngoo a yimɓe moƴƴe. Ala, yafara u ɓaɓɓitini an (i.e. saayii) kan, an ɓiɓɓe u leelii (e saayaa), nin u ɓaɓɓitini an e laadamoo.
160.instruction: (Allaahumma 'a'ith-hu min 'athaabil-qabri.) [or say:](Allahummaj-AAalhu faratan, wathukhran liwalidayh, washafeeAAan mujaban. Allahumma thaqqil bihi mawazeenahuma wa-aAAthim bihi ojoorahuma, wa-alhiqhu bisalihil-mu'mineen, wajAAalhu fee kafalati Ibraheem, waqihi birahmatika AAathabal-jaheem, wa 'abdilhu daaran khayran min daarihi, wa 'ahlan khayran min 'ahlihi, Allaahum-maghfir li'aslaafinaa, wa afraatinaa wa man sabaqanaa bil'eemaan)

161.translation: (Ala, waɗoo a an la ɓaɓɓitoo, fewitoo nin sooro)

162.translation: (Tiɲɛtɛŋo, Alla jago ko O ɓooni, A jago ko O hokkini, bɛɛ A la e sahaa tootoo...kɔfɛ a yamirni a ñooftoo nin Alla sooro hope.)(Kumaaji (faltasbir waltahtasib) ko yamirooji musoo sabaŋoo la, u yɛlɛtata e mo miiraa la.)
162.instruction: (Inna lillahi ma akhath, walahu ma aAAta, wakullu shayin AAindahu bi-ajalin musamma…faltasbir waltahtasib.)

163.translation: (Alla taa la, Alla Kɛmɛ sunnati kan.)

164.translation: Ala, yafara a. Ala, semmboo a

165.translation: (Saafee iɓe kan, maanaŋ u jagonooɓe, nder laadamintooɓe nin muslimɓe. Tiɲɛtɛŋo an, Alla miirina, wallotoo iɓe la, an Alla waraafinoo ɲinoo an nin iɓe la.)
165.instruction: (Assalamu AAalaykum ahlad-diyari minal-mu/mineena walmuslimeen, wa-inna in shaal-lahu bikum lahiqoon, nas-alul-laha lana walakumul-AAafiyah.)

166.translation: (Ala, n I ɲinoo a moƴƴee, n dɔŋ I la e a jumaŋoo.)
166.instruction: (Allahumma innee as-aluka khayraha wa-aAAoothu bika min sharriha.)

167.translation: (Ala, n I ɲinoo a moƴƴee, moƴƴee nder mum, nin moƴƴee a neldinii e mum, n dɔŋ I la e a jumaŋoo, jumaŋoo nder mum, nin jumaŋoo a neldinii e mum.)
167.instruction: (Allahumma innee as-aluka khayraha wakhayra ma feeha, wakhayra ma orsilat bih, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharriha, washarri ma feeha washarri ma orsilat bih.)

168.translation: (A meeñaani, (O) min ƙarŋo wiitoo A meeñugoo e A tanuu, malaa'ikaw fana e A kuloo.)

169.translation: (Ala, walloo an e sanji walloo, ɲoofoo, tandoo, nafaa, alaa naasii, jooni, alaa kɔfɛ.)
169.instruction: (Allahummas-qina ghaythan mugheethan maree-an mureeAAan, nafiAAan, ghayra dar, AAajilan ghayra ajil.)

170.translation: (Ala, walloo an, Ala, walloo an, Ala, walloo an.)

171.translation: (Ala, jii hokkoo I baaroolu nin I neema, yiitoo I hinɛ, ɲaŋoo I leydi saayaaɗi.)
171.instruction: (Allahummas-qi AAibadak, wabaha-imak, wanshur rahmatak, wa-ahyi baladakal-mayyit.)

173.translation: (An hokkiraa sanji e Alla nafaa nin A hinɛ.)

174.translation: (Ala, waɗoo sanji ɓaddoo an yeeli, alaa an kan, Ala, (a ɓaddoo) leereeji kan, buluuji, kooruuji, nin u jinjii. )
174.instruction: (Allahumma hawalayna wala AAalayna, allahumma AAalal-akami waththirab, wabutoonil-awdiyah, wamanabitish-shajar.)

175.translation: (Alla bɛlaa. Ala, waɗoo lewruu keraa feeñoo an kan e saafee, laadamoo, jam, nin Lislaam, nin jaaboo e bɛɛ I yiɗi min tanɗoo I. An Maraa nin i Maraa ko Alla.)
175.instruction: (Allahu akbar, allahumma ahillahu AAalayna bil-amni wal-eeman, wassalamati wal-islam, wattawfeeiqi lima tuhibbu watarda, rabbuna warabbukal-lah.)

176.translation: (Kɔŋoo yaa, dembooji jooɗii, sooro tabtabitinaa, so Alla miirina.)

177.translation: (Ala, n I ɲinoo e I hinɛ min jaŋŋarii bɛɛ, I yafara n.)
177.instruction: (Allahumma inne as-aluka birahmatikal-latee wasiAAat kulla shay, an taghfira lee.)

178.translation: (So i ngonoo ŋamoo, i ka wiyi:(Bismil-lah.)so i mooftinii a wiyi puɗɗoo kan, i ka wiyi (so i mooftiniri):Alla taa la a puɗɗoo nin a kɔfɛ.)
178.instruction: (So i ngonoo ŋamoo, i ka wiyi:(Bismil-lah.)so i mooftinii a wiyi puɗɗoo kan, i ka wiyi (so i mooftiniri):Bismil-lahi fee awwalihi wa-akhirih.)

179.translation: (Mo Alla ŋaminni, a ka wiyi:(Ala, barkoo a an la, ŋaminoo an e ɓurngoo a moƴƴe.) mo Alla haŋŋiirinni yaraa, a ka wiyi:(Ala, barkoo a an la, ɓeydoo an e mum.))
179.instruction: (Mo Alla ŋaminni, a ka wiyi:(Allahumma barik lana feehi wa-atAAimna khayran minh.) mo Alla haŋŋiirinni yaraa, a ka wiyi:(Allahumma barik lana feehi wazidna minh.))

180.translation: (Tanuu bɛɛ fɔ Alla la min ŋaminni n o, rizqinni n a, alaa sembe walla se e n.)
180.instruction: (Alhamdu lillahil-lathee atAAamanee hatha warazaqaneehi min ghayri hawlin minnee wala quwwah.)

181.translation: (Alla tantanaa e tanuu jɛlen ɲuman barikaman, tanuu te kɔfɛ mooftii, tanuu an te woodaa yeeli, tanuu min an te waaya suutoo, A le mu an Maraa.)(Miijooji goɗɗi woodi e faamoo du'aa nin, nder mum: Alla tantanaa e tanuu jɛlen ɲuman barikaman. A le mu Hoore-fotoo, ŋamintoo, ŋamintoo moo. O miiraa, e ko A la, O jiiɓaa, A le mu an Maraa.)
181.instruction: (Alhamdu lillahi hamdan katheeran tayyiban mubarakan feeh, ghayra makfiyyin wala muwaddaAAin, wala mustaghnan AAanhu rabbuna.)

182.translation: (Ala, barkoo u la, ko I rizqinni u, yafara u, hinɛ kɛ u ma.)
182.instruction: (Allahumma barik lahum feema razaqtahum, waghfir lahum warhamhum.)

183.translation: (Ala, ŋaminoo mo ŋaminni n, haŋŋiirinoo yaraa mo haŋŋiirinni n yaraa.)
183.instruction: (Allahumma atAAim man atAAamanee wasqi man saqanee.)

184.translation: (Sunoow ka u sunoo fee iɓe soo, goongaaniiɓe ka iɓe ŋamoo ŋamoo, malaa'ikaw salaa iɓe kan.)

185.translation: (N'i wele (fɛɛn la) i ka jaabi. N'i sun bɛ, i ka ɲini (moo minw woodi) ma, n'i tɛ sun, i ka fɛɛn dun.)
185.instruction: (N'i wele (fɛɛn la) i ka jaabi. N'i sun bɛ, i ka ɲini (moo minw woodi) ma, n'i tɛ sun, i ka fɛɛn dun.)

187.translation: (Ala, barkoo an furiijeeji an la, barkoo an duuniya an la, barkoo an saAA an la, barkoo an mudd an la.)(SaAA kelen kelen no mudd nɑɑ, mudd kelen no moo hakkundee-woo boloo ɗiɓi laŋoo miinoo.)
187.instruction: (Allahumma barik lana fee thamarina, wabarik lana fee madeenatina, wabarik lana fee saAAina wabarik lana fee muddina.)

188.translation: (So iɓe do ɓasii, a ka wiyi:(Tanuu bɛɛ fɔ Alla la.) a ɓalaaŋoo walla a kondirtoo ka wiyi a la: (Alla hinɛ kɛ I.) a (i.e. ɓasiiɗo) jaabaa a:(Alla fewinoo I, ɲɛjira kɛ I haalaa la.))
188.instruction: (So iɓe do ɓasii, a ka wiyi:(Alhamdu lillah.) a ɓalaaŋoo walla a kondirtoo ka wiyi a la: (Yarhamukal-lah.) a (i.e. ɓasiiɗo) jaabaa a:(Yahdeekumul-lahu wayuslihu balakum.))

189.translation: (Alla fewinoo I, ɲɛjira kɛ I haalaa la.)

190.translation: (Alla barkoo I la (I musoo), barkoo I, waɗoo O walloo iɓe ɗiɓi e moƴƴe.)
190.instruction: (Barakal-lahu lak, wabaraka AAalayk, wajamaAAa baynakuma fee khayr.)

191.translation: (so i furirii musoo walla i soodii baaroodoo, i ka wiyi:(Ala, n I ɲinoo moƴƴee nder a nin moƴƴee I waɗini a jangoo e mum, n dɔŋ I la e jumaŋoo nder a nin jumaŋoo I waɗini a jangoo e mum.))(so i soodii laaɓo, i ka jaabaa a ŋaŋŋoo, wiyi no o.)
191.instruction: (so i furirii musoo walla i soodii baaroodoo, i ka wiyi: (Allahumma innee as-aluka khayraha wakhayra ma jabaltaha AAalayh, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharriha washarrima jabaltaha AAalayh.))(so i soodii laaɓo, i ka jaabaa a ŋaŋŋoo, wiyi no o.)

192.translation: (Alla taa la. Ala, woddoo seytaan e an, woddoo seytaan e ko I barkinni an e mum.)

193.translation: (N dɔŋ Alla la e seytaan tufitoo.)

194.translation: (Tanuu bɛɛ fɔ Alla la min hisninni n e ko O lajɛlni I e mum, min ɓurnini n moƴƴoo e A daadaa ɓurɓe.)
194.instruction: (Alhamdu lillahil-lathee AAafanee mimmab-talaka bih, wafaddalanee AAala katheerin mimman khalaqa tafdeela.)

195.translation: (Ibn AAumar wiyi: limiraa ko Alla Kɛmɛ wiyi biɲi teeme e jooŋoo koo kan puɗɗoo a wuloo: (N Maraa, yafara n, ruttoo n la (jaabugoo n tobubugoo). Tiɲɛtɛŋo I le mu Ruttoo-juutoo, Yaafaree-juutoo.))
195.instruction: (Ibn AAumar wiyi: limiraa ko Alla Kɛmɛ wiyi biɲi teeme e jooŋoo koo kan puɗɗoo a wuloo: (Rabbigh-fir lee watub AAalay, innaka antat-tawwabul-ghafoor.))

196.translation: (I meeñaani Ala, n I tanuu. N shahaadaa moolu te suutee moo la fo I ye. N I yaafaa ɲinoo n ruttoo I la tobubugoo.)
196.instruction: (Subhanakal-lahumma wabihamdik, ashhadu an la ilaha illa ant, astaghfiruka wa-atoobu ilayk.)

197.translation: (AAabdullah Ibn Sarjis kuma: 'N taa Nelaa lajɛ, n ŋamii a fɛɛn, o sahaa n a fɔ a ma: (Alla ka I yafaa, Alla Kɛmɛ.) a jaabi: (nin I fana.)'
197.instruction: (AAabdullah Ibn Sarjis kuma: 'N taa Nelaa lajɛ, n ŋamii a fɛɛn, o sahaa n a fɔ a ma:(Ghafaral-lahu laka ya rasoolal-lah.) a jaabi: (wa-lak))

198.translation: (N'a moo I moƴƴee kɛni, i ka fɔ: (Alla ka I sara moƴƴee ye.) i tiɲɛtɛŋoo a kumaɲi.)
198.instruction: (N'a moo I moƴƴee kɛni, i ka fɔ: (Jazakal-lahu khayran.) i tiɲɛtɛŋoo a kumaɲi.)

199.translation: (Dajjal: nder maandeeji mawɗi Wakkati Cakkitiingol nin fitinooji sanŋa mawɗi u ɓaddata moolu, Nelaa koo ɓaɓɓitini e mum. Moolu ɓurɓe ɓaddata a jokkoo. A feeñira Asbahan, Iran so Muslimɓe maa Qusṭanṭiniya jaami. A hokkirata semmbe ceeɓoo, a waɗata goonga yeewa no naa-goonga, naa-goonga no goonga. A miijata hoore goongaano, kɔfɛ a miijata nelaaŋo, cakkitiiŋoo mawoo. A maandeeji: a ɲaahaa ñaamere ɓaddata, o ko seedee tiɲɛ min jabbaa a miijoo hoore Alla, sabu o maandee alaa-meeñugoo. Kuma Kafir binndoo da hakkunde a ɲaahaaɗi, laadamintoo bee, binndoowo walla mo binndaa, bɛɛ anndoo.)

200.translation: (O min I nɛɛ n ma, a ka I nɛɛ.)

201.translation: (Alla barkoo I la, I yimɓe nin I jawdi.)

202.translation: (Alla barkoo I la, I yimɓe nin I jawdi. Tiɲɛtɛŋo tanuu nin lomtoo ko sooro banŋoo.)
202.instruction: (Barakal-lahu laka fee ahlika wamalik, innama jaza-os-salafil-hamdu wal-ada'.)

203.translation: (shirk: boleeɗe goɗɓe Alla la e u ceeɓee A la. Ɗum waawi kɛraa e (1) laadamoo, i.e. laadamoo goɗɗo alaa Alla se si nafaa walla naasii, (2) kumoo, i.e. hunndee e goɗɗo alaa Alla, (3) baara, i.e. raajoo walla sujudoo goɗɗo alaa Alla.)(Ala, n dɔŋ I la kana n shirkii I e anndee, n I yaafaa ɲinoo e ko n waɗoo e alaa-anndee.)
203.instruction: (shirk: boleeɗe goɗɓe Alla la e u ceeɓee A la. Ɗum waawi kɛraa e (1) laadamoo, i.e. laadamoo goɗɗo alaa Alla se si nafaa walla naasii, (2) kumoo, i.e. hunndee e goɗɗo alaa Alla, (3) baara, i.e. raajoo walla sujudoo goɗɗo alaa Alla.)(Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika an oshrika bika wa-ana aAAlam, wa-astaghfiruka lima la aAAlam.)

204.translation: (Aaishah fii ko Alla Kɛmɛ hokkiraa lembere, a yamirni a fecee. So baaroo ruttii (e a fecee), AAaishah ɲinoo: 'Ɗume u wiyi?', a jaabii: Ɓe du'aa: (Alla barkoo iɓe bɛɛ.) AAaishah kɔfɛ wiyi: (nin Alla barkoo u.))(an lomtoo u du'aa e laawal no o, an sooro to an la.)
204.instruction: (Aaishah fii ko Alla Kɛmɛ hokkiraa lembere, a yamirni a fecee. So baaroo ruttii (e a fecee), AAaishah ɲinoo: 'Ɗume u wiyi?', a jaabii: Ɓe du'aa: (Barakal-lahu feekum.) AAaishah kɔfɛ wiyi: (Wafeehim barakal-lah.))(an lomtoo u du'aa e laawal no o, an sooro to an la.)

205.translation: (Du'aa nin kɛraa so moo miijii fukkoo ko ɓattaŋoo walla fɛn-ɓattaŋoo wiitoo moƴƴe walla jumaŋo, a huutortoo o laŋoo faamoo baara min a waɗata, kɔfɛ a yaaɓii laŋoo o, dɔŋ Alla la, kɔfɛ a wiyi du'aa nin no laaɓoo baara nin, sabu a ɓata nder shirk.)(Ala, wiitoo alaa fo I dɔŋoo woodi, moƴƴe alaa fo I moƴƴee, moolu te suutee moo la fo I ye.)
205.instruction: (Du'aa nin kɛraa so moo miijii fukkoo ko ɓattaŋoo walla fɛn-ɓattaŋoo wiitoo moƴƴe walla jumaŋo, a huutortoo o laŋoo faamoo baara min a waɗata, kɔfɛ a yaaɓii laŋoo o, dɔŋ Alla la, kɔfɛ a wiyi du'aa nin no laaɓoo baara nin, sabu a ɓata nder shirk.)(Allahumma la tayra illa tayruk, wala khayra illa khayruk, wala ilaha ghayruk.)

206.translation: (Alla taa la, tanuu bɛɛ fɔ Alla la. A meeñaani, O min o (jaango) to an gollinoo, an hoore te waaya o, an Maraa la ko an ruttotoo cakkitiiŋoo. Tanuu bɛɛ fɔ Alla la, tanuu bɛɛ fɔ Alla la, tanuu bɛɛ fɔ Alla la, Alla bɛlaa, Alla bɛlaa, Alla bɛlaa. I meeñaani, Ala, tiɲɛtɛŋo n tooñii n neɗɗaagal, yafara n, sabu tiɲɛtɛŋo moolu te yaafara juŋooji fo I ye.)
206.instruction: (Bismil-lah, walhamdu lillah, subhanal-lathee sakhkhara lana hatha wama kunna lahu muqrineen, wainna ila rabbina lamunqaliboon, alhamdu lillah, alhamdu lillah, alhamdu lillah, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, subhanakal-lahumma innee thalamtu nafsee faghfir lee fainnahu la yaghfiruth-thunooba illa ant.)

207.translation: (Alla bɛlaa, Alla bɛlaa, Alla bɛlaa, A meeñaani, O min o (jaango) to an gollinoo, an hoore te waaya o, an Maraa la ko an ruttotoo cakkitiiŋoo. Ala, an I ɲinoo birr nin taqwaa e safaroo nin an, an I ɲinoo baaraaji u tanɗoo I. Ala, weecoo an safaroo, waɗoo an feewoo a woddee weecoo. Ala, I le mu Kondirtoo safaroo kan, Jaltintoo yimɓe kan, Ala, n dɔŋ I la e safaroo gɛlɛyooji, e xeluuji yɛlɛtee nin haalaa jumaŋo, n dɔŋ I la e kɔfɛ-jumaŋo jawdi nin yimɓe la.)(birr nin taqwaa: kumaaji ɗiɓi jawtaree u, koo kelen, miirtoo baara moƴƴeeji bɛɛ nin yamiroo i.e. waɗoo baara yamiraaɓe, wuluu baara haɗaaɓe. So u wallinii, birr miirtoo waɗoo u yamiraaɓe, taqwaa miirtoo wuluu u haɗaaɓe.)(Jaltintoo: moo jaltintoo goɗɗo sabu a alaa-woodugoo walla a saayaa. Ɗum le mu kuma khaleefah goonga maanaa; ko nde, goonga alaa laadamoo Adam le mu Alla khaleefah leydi kan sabu Alla alaa mooftii, A te saayoo mooftii. Du'aa nin seedoo maanaa goonga kuma nin, hollitoo Alla jaltintoo an, aanaa u an accii kɔfɛ so an saayi walla an alaa.)(so a ruttii, du'aa no mum kɛraa e ɓeydoo nin: (An ruttii, an tobubugoo, an baaroo, an tantanaa an Maraa.))
207.instruction: (Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, subhanal-lathee sakhkhara lana hatha wama kunna lahu muqrineen, wa-inna ila rabbina lamunqaliboon, allahumma inna nas-aluka fee safarina hatha albirra wattaqwa, waminal-AAamali ma tarda, allahumma hawwin AAalayna safarana hatha, watwi AAanna buAAdah, allahumma antas-sahibu fis-safar, walkhaleefatu fil-ahl, allahumma innee aAAoothu bika min waAAtha-is-safar, waka-abatil-manthar, wasoo-il-munqalabi fil-mali wal-ahl.)(upon returning the same supplication is recited with the following addition: (Ayiboona, ta-iboona, AAabidoona, lirabbina hamidoon.))

208.translation: (Ala, sanjiw jee-jee Maraa nin bɛɛ u suyata, leydi jee-jee Maraa nin bɛɛ u jaɓoo, setaniw Maraa nin u jallini, henɗiw Maraa nin bɛɛ u liiɓoo. N I ɲinoo duuniya nin moƴƴee, a u nder moƴƴee, nin moƴƴee bɛɛ woodoo nder mum, n dɔŋ I la e duuniya nin jumaŋoo, a u nder jumaŋoo, nin jumaŋoo bɛɛ woodoo nder mum.)
208.instruction: (Allahumma rabbas-samawatis-sabAAi wama athlaln, warabbal-aradeenas-sabAAi wama aqlaln, warabbash-shayateeni wama adlaln, warabbar-riyahi wama tharayn, as-aluka khayra hathihil-qaryah, wakhayra ahlilha wakhayra ma feeha, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharriha washarri ahliha, washarri ma feeha.)

209.translation: (Moolu te suutee moo la fo Ala, A tokoo, alaa mɔɔ, A le mu laamu nin tanuu. A hokkoo ɲaŋo, A hokkoo saayaa, A ɲaŋoo, A te saayoo. A bolo kɔnɔ ko moƴƴe bɛɛ, A bɛ se fɛn bɛɛ la.)
209.instruction: (La ilaha illal-lah,  wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, yuhyee wayumeetu wahuwa hayyun la yamoot, biyadihil-khayru wahuwa  AAala kulli shayin qadeer.)

211.translation: (N I to Alla aminaa bolo, min aminaa te leeloo mooftii.)

212.translation: (N I diine, I goongaa, nin I baaraaji banbaji to Alla aminaa bolo.)

213.translation: (Alla hokkoo I taqwaa, yafara I juŋooji, weecoo moƴƴe bɛɛ I la, yɔrɔ min I woni.)(taqwaa: kuma jawtaree min miirtoo baara moƴƴeeji bɛɛ nin yamiroo i.e. waɗoo baara yamiraaɓe, wuluu baara haɗaaɓe.)
213.instruction: (Zawwadakal-lahut-taqwa, waghafara thanbak, wayassara lakal-khayra haythuma kunt.)

214.translation: Jabir wiyi: Saha koo an ɓaddii bulu, an bɛ wiyi Allaahu 'Akber (Alla bɛlaa) so an jippii an bɛ wiyi Subhaanallaah (Alla meeñaani)

215.translation: (Seedoo, seedoo an tanuu Alla e A nafaaji nin A barkikaaji an kan. An Maraa, kisoo an, moƴƴoo an kan, hisnoo an e jumaŋo koo. N dɔŋ Alla la e jasiika.)
215.instruction: (SamiAAa samiAAun bihamdil-lahi wahusni bala-ihi AAalayna. Rabbana sahibna wa-afdil AAalayna AAa-ithan billahi minan-nar.)

216.translation: (N dɔŋ Alla kuma dafalenw la e jumaŋoo min A daani.)

217.translation: (Ibn AAumar fii ko Alla Kɛmɛ, so a ruttii kaɓoo walla a hajjoo kɔfɛ, a bɛ wiyi bulu koo kan: (Alla bɛlaa, Alla bɛlaa, Alla bɛlaa.) kɔfɛ a bɛ wiyi: (Moolu te suutee moo la fo Ala, A tokoo, alaa mɔɔ. A le mu laamu nin tanuu, A bɛ se fɛn bɛɛ la. An ruttii, an tobubugoo, an baaroo, an tantanaa an Maraa. Alla timmini A ɓoɗɗal, wallii A baaroo, a tokoo jaamii bolokoloba.))
217.instruction: (Ibn AAumar fii ko Alla Kɛmɛ, so a ruttii kaɓoo walla a hajjoo kɔfɛ, a bɛ wiyi bulu koo kan: (Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar.) kɔfɛ a bɛ wiyi: (La ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shay-in qadeer, ayiboona ta-iboon, AAabidoon, lirabbina hamidoon, sadaqal-lahu waAAdah, wanasara AAabdah, wahazamal-ahzaba wahdah.))

218.translation: So ko ɓattani min tanɗinii a, Nelaa bɛ wiyi:((Alhamdu lillaahil-lathee bini'matihi tatimmuus-saalihaat)). Tanuu fɔ Alla la min A barkikaaji la moƴƴeeji bɛɛ timminoo. So ko ɓattani min tanɗinii a, a bɛ wiyi:((Alhamdulillaahi 'alaa kulli haal)).Tanuu fɔ Alla la e haalaa bɛɛ.
218.instruction: So ko ɓattani min tanɗinii a, Nelaa bɛ wiyi:((Alhamdu lillaahil-lathee bini'matihi tatimmuus-saalihaat)).So ko ɓattani min tanɗinii a, a bɛ wiyi:((Alhamdulillaahi 'alaa kulli haal)).

219.translation: (Nelaa (PBUH) wiyi: 'Mo salaa n kan kelen, Alla salaa a kan tan.)

220.translation: (A (PBUH) wiyi fana: 'Kana n maanaŋ kɛ natee-yaaya jagonoo. Salaa n kan, sabu tiɲɛtɛŋo i salaaji ɓaddoo n, yɔrɔ min i woni.)

221.translation: (A (PBUH) wiyi fana: 'Mbolooɗo ko mo so n miiraa a la, a alaa salaa n kan.)

222.translation: Nelaa [PBUH] wiyi:'Tiɲɛtɛŋo Alla jogoo malaa'ikaw u yaaya leydi kan, u ɓaddoo n saafee-ɓeɓɓitooji n 'Ummah (umma).

223.translation: Nelaa [PBUH] wiyi: 'Moolu te saafee-ɓeɓɓitoo n kan fo Alla lomtoo n ruuhoo n la kana n lomtoo a saafee.

224.translation: (Alla Kɛmɛ wiyi: 'I te donoo jannat juutiŋo i laadamini, i te laadamino juutiŋo i nɛɛ ɲoŋoŋo. Kana mi hollitoo i ko, so i waɗini a kan, i tiɲɛtɛŋoo nɛɛ-ɲoŋoŋo: Yiitoo saafee nder i hoore.)

225.translation: (Aammar wiyi: 'Ɓe meeñi saba, mo wallinii u, a timminii a laadamoo: ñiyaasoo, yiitoo saafee moolu bɛɛ la, hokkoo (sadaqa) e fitinoo I jogoo.)

226.translation: (Aabdullah Ibn Aamr fii ko moo ɲinii Nelaa: 'Lislaam min ɓurnoo moƴƴe?'. A jaabii: Ɲaminoo (leelooɓe), saafee-ɓeɓɓitoo u I anndu nin u I anndaa.)

227.translation: (So Kitabu moolu saafee-ɓeɓɓitinii I, jaaboo e wiyi: (I kan fana.))

228.translation: (So I menno yɛrɛŋo ŋaaŋoo, ɲinoo Alla A nafaa sabu a ɲaahii malaa'ika, so I menno jaɓɓo ɓaaŋoo, dɔŋ Alla la sabu a ɲaahii seytaan.)

229.translation: (So I menno wuriiji woŋoo walla jaɓɓooji ɓaaŋoo jamma, dɔŋ Alla la sabu u ɲaahoo ko I ɲaahaa.)

230.translation: (Ala, laadamintoo koo n yaañinii, waɗoo o kɛraa sababu ɓadoo a I la Ñalnde Walliree.)
230.instruction: (Allahumma fa-ayyuma mu/minin sababtuhu fajAAal thalika lahu qurbatan ilayka yawmal-qiyamah.)

231.translation: (A wiyi: 'So iɓe do yamiraa tantanoo a ɓalaaŋoo, a ka wiyi: 'N faamoo ko-ɓalaaŋoo no...Alla le mu a jateeɗo...n tantanaa moo, tommboo (i.e. n tantanoo) Alla kumaɲi ɲaaha ŋaahaa, ammaa n faamoo a no ko-ɓalaaŋoo'...so a anndinaa o e mum.)

232.translation: Ala, kana n jatee e ko u wiyi, yafara n e ko u anndaa [waɗoo n ɓurngoo moƴƴe ko u faamoo]
232.instruction: Allaahumma laa tu'aakhithnee bimaa yaqooloona, waghfir lee maa laa ya'lamoona [waj'alnee khayram-mimmaa yadhunnoon]

233.translation: (Mi ngoodi Ala, (e jaabugoo I noddaal), mi ngoodi. Mi ngoodi, mɔɔ alaa I, mi ngoodi. Tiɲɛtɛŋo tanuu bɛɛ, hinɛ nin laamu ko I jago. Mɔɔ alaa I.)
233.instruction: (Labbaykal-lahumma labbayk, labbayka la shareeka laka labbayk, innal-hamda wanniAAmata laka walmulk, la shareeka lak.)

234.translation: (Nelaa wulirii KaAAbah laaɓo kan, saha koo a ɓaddii ɓalee ɓaleŋo a holliri a e a jaŋgo, wiyi: (Alla bɛlaa))
234.instruction: (Nelaa wulirii KaAAbah laaɓo kan, saha koo a ɓaddii ɓalee ɓaleŋo a holliri a e a jaŋgo, wiyi: (Allahu akbar))

235.translation: Nelaa PBUH bɛ wiyi hakkunde Yemen yɔrɔ nin ɓalee ɓaleŋo: (An Maraa, hokkoo an ɓurngoo moƴƴe e ɲaŋo nin, ɓurngoo moƴƴe e kɔfɛ, kisoo an e Jasiika jaŋŋaralaa.)
