235.instruction: Nelaa PBUH bɛ wiyi hakkunde Yemen yɔrɔ nin ɓalee ɓaleŋo: (Rabbana atina fee alddunya hasanatan wafee al-akhirati hasanatan waqina AAathaban-nar.)

236.translation: (Jabir wiyi so a sifoo Nelaa hajjoo: '...so a ɓadii bulu Safa a karinii: (Tiɲɛtɛŋo Safa nin Marwah ko Alla baaroo-nokkuuji...) (N puɗɗoo e ko Alla puɗɗinii e mum.) a puɗɗii e Safa, ɓaddii a juutiŋo a waayi ɲaahaa KaAAbah, a yeeli a, wiyi: (Alla bɛlaa, Alla bɛlaa, Alla bɛlaa.) kɔfɛ a bɛ wiyi kɔfɛ-ɗoo saba kɔ, du'aa kɛraa (moo ka du'aa hoore kɛ) saha koo kɔfɛ: (Moolu te suutee moo la fo Ala, A tokoo, alaa mɔɔ. A le mu laamu nin tanuu, A bɛ se fɛn bɛɛ la. Moolu te suutee moo la fo Ala tokoo. A timminii A ɓoɗɗal, wallii A baaroo, a tokoo jaamii bolokoloba.)) (a bɛ waɗoo nin lomtoo Marwah.)
236.instruction: (Jabir wiyi so a sifoo Nelaa hajjoo: '...so a ɓadii bulu Safa a karinii: ( Innas-safa wa-almarwata min shaAAa-iri Allah ….) (Abda-o bima badaal-lahu bih.) a puɗɗii e Safa, ɓaddii a juutiŋo a waayi ɲaahaa KaAAbah, a yeeli a, wiyi: (Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar.) kɔfɛ a bɛ wiyi kɔfɛ-ɗoo saba kɔ, du'aa kɛraa (moo ka du'aa hoore kɛ) saha koo kɔfɛ: (La ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeer, la ilaha illal-lahu wahdah, anjaza waAAdah, wanasara AAabdah, wahazamal -ahzaba wahdah.)(a bɛ waɗoo nin lomtoo Marwah.)

237.translation: (Du'aa ɓurngoo moƴƴe ko du'aa ñalnde AAarafah, ɓurngoo moƴƴe min n nin Nelaaɓe kan kan wiyi (ko): (Moolu te suutee moo la fo Ala, A tokoo, alaa mɔɔ. A le mu tanuu nin laamu, A bɛ se fɛn bɛɛ la.))
237.instruction: (Du'aa ɓurngoo moƴƴe ko du'aa ñalnde AAarafah, ɓurngoo moƴƴe min n nin Nelaaɓe kan kan wiyi (ko): (La ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeer.))

238.translation: Nelaa nɔɓii a nɔɓoo Al-Qaswa fo a se yɔrɔ niimo la (Al-Mash aril Haraam). O sahaa a ɲɛ Qiblah ma, ka ɲini Ala, a kuma fo: Allaahu Akbar (Ala bɛlaa), Allaahu Ahad (Ala kelen) nin Laa ilaaha illallaah (Moo tɛ Ala tɛ). A tooŋoo fo sanjɛ kɛra jɛ su ɲɛ, o kɔfɛ a yahinii su bɔ ɲɛ.

239.translation: Nelaa PBUH wiyi Allaahu 'Akbar (Ala bɛlaa) ɓurundoo o ɓurundoo min a tɔnni tɛmɛsɛn sabaw kan. O sahaa a yahii ɲɛ, a tooŋoo ɲɛ Qiblah ma, k'a bolow ɓaɓɓi ka Ala nodoo. O kɛra (tɔnoo) tɛmɛsɛn fukkoo nin ɗiɓaɓɗo kɔfɛ. Tataɓɗo la, a tɔnni a, a wiyi Allaahu Akbar ɓurundoo o ɓurundoo la, nka a bana a yahi tɛ tooŋoo a la (du'aaji kama).

242.translation: (Nelaa PBUH bɛ sujudoo juŋaŋaaroo Alla la so kabaaroo ɓaddini min tanɗinii a walla min sefininii.)

243.translation: (To I boloo ɓaloo-yɔrɔ kan, wiyi: (Alla taa la (saba kɔ)) kɔfɛ du'aa biɲi jee-jee: (N dɔŋ Alla la nin A se e jumaŋoo min n hijoo, min n ɓaɓɓitoo e mum.))
243.instruction: (To I boloo ɓaloo-yɔrɔ kan, wiyi: (Bismil-lah (saba kɔ)) kɔfɛ du'aa biɲi jee-jee: (aAAoothu billahi waqudratih min sharri ma ajid wa-ohathir.))

244.translation: So I ɲaahii ko I ɓalaaŋoo la min tanɗinii I, walla a hoore walla a jawdi la [ɲinoo Alla barkoo a e mum] sabu yiyaa-ɲaahaa ko goonga.

245.translation: (Moolu te suutee moo la fo Alla.)

246.translation: (Alla taa la, Alla bɛlaa. Ala, (a le) e I, A jago I, Ala, jaabaaraa o e n.)
246.instruction: (Bismil-lah wallahu akbar, allahumma minka walak, allahumma taqabbal  minnee.)

247.translation: (N dɔŋ Alla kuma dafalenw kɔnɔ u goongaano walla naa-goongaano te waaya u kɔfɛ, e jumaŋoo bɛɛ min A daani, waɗini, fuɗɗini. (N dɔŋ) e jumaŋoo jippitoo e jamalu, jumaŋoo ɓadditoo a la. (N dɔŋ) e jumaŋoo yiitoo leydi kan, jumaŋo fuɗɗitoo e mum, n dɔŋ e jumaŋoo fitinooji jamma nin weleerela, jumaŋoo ɓadditoo jamma fo min ɓadditoo e moƴƴe, Yiurndeeɗo.)
247.instruction: (aAAoothu bikalimatil-lahit-tammat, allatee la yujawizuhunna barrun wala fajir min sharri ma khalaq, wabaraa watharaa, wamin sharri ma yanzilu minas-sama/, wamin sharri ma yaAAruju feeha, wamin sharri ma tharaa fil-ard, wamin sharri ma yakhruju minha, wamin sharri fitnanil-layli wannahar, wamin sharri kulli tariqin illa tariqan yatruqu bikhayrin ya Rahman.)

248.translation: (Alla Kɛmɛ wiyi: 'Alla kan, n Alla yaafaa ɲinoo, tobubugoo Alla la, ɓuri biɲi jee-jee juutiŋo tan e ñalnde.)

249.translation: (A wiyi fana: 'Moo, tobubugoo! Tiɲɛtɛŋo n tobubugoo Alla la, biɲi teeme e ñalnde.)

250.translation: (A wiyi fana: 'Mo wiyi:(N Alla yaafaa ɲinoo, min kɔfɛ, moolu te suutee moo la fo A ye, Aɲaŋoo-taa, Hoore-taayaa ani Fow Taamintoo, n ruttoo A la tobubugoo.) Alla yaafaraa a hali so a wonnoo mo doggii jaŋgoo ɓaɓɓoo kan.)
250.instruction: (A wiyi fana: 'Mo wiyi:(Astaghfirul-lahal-lathee la ilaha illa huwal-hayyul-qayyoomu wa-atoobu ilayh.) Alla yaafaraa a hali so a wonnoo mo doggii jaŋgoo ɓaɓɓoo kan.)

251.translation: (A wiyi: 'Maraa ɓadiirta a baaroo ko jamma hakkundee, so I waayi woodugoo nder u mooftiirtoo Alla sahaa o, wonoo.)

252.translation: (A wiyi fana: 'Baaroo ɓadiirta a Maraa ko a sujudoo, du'aa ɗuuɗoo nder mum.)

253.translation: (A wiyi fana: 'tiɲɛtɛŋo n xeloo ɓataa hijoo, tiɲɛtɛŋo n Alla yaafaa ɲinoo biɲi teeme e ñalnde.)(hijoo: i.e. e haalaa 'mooftiirtee'. Nelaa bɛ ɓeydoo saha koo e a Maraa mooftiirtee, ɓadoo Alla la nin Alla hijoo juutiŋo so juutiŋo o leelinii e laawal koo, a lajɛraa a no juŋoo, haɗoo ɓaddoo yaafaa-ɲinoo Alla la.)

254.translation: (Mo wiyi:(Alla meeñaani, n A tanuu.) biɲi teeme e ñalnde, a juŋooji suturaa, hali so u no maaree humoo.)
254.instruction: (Mo wiyi:(Subhanal-lahi wabihamdih.) biɲi teeme e ñalnde, a juŋooji suturaa, hali so u no maaree humoo.)

255.translation: (Abu Hurayrah fii ko Alla Kɛmɛ wiyi: 'Mo wiyi: (Moolu te suutee moo la fo Ala, A tokoo, alaa mɔɔ. A le mu laamu nin tanuu, A bɛ se fɛn bɛɛ la.) biɲi teeme e ñalnde, jogoo sooro doggooɓe tan ɓeytinoo, moƴƴeeji teeme binndaa a la, jumaŋooji teeme suturaa, a woodii kisoo e seytaan ñalnde o juutiŋo suunoo, moolu te ɓaddoo e ɓurngoo o moƴƴe fo mo waɗini ɓuri.
255.instruction: (Abu Hurayrah fii ko Alla Kɛmɛ wiyi: 'Mo wiyi: (La ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeer.) biɲi teeme e ñalnde, jogoo sooro doggooɓe tan ɓeytinoo, moƴƴeeji teeme binndaa a la, jumaŋooji teeme suturaa, a woodii kisoo e seytaan ñalnde o juutiŋo suunoo, moolu te ɓaddoo e ɓurngoo o moƴƴe fo mo waɗini ɓuri.

256.translation: (Aboo Hurayrah fii ko Alla Kɛmɛ wiyi:'(Ɓe woodi) kumaaji ɗiɗi, (u) leecoo e nummoo, juutoo e Miinaa kan, yiɗaa e Yiurndee-juutoo la: (Alla meeñaani, n A tanuu. Alla meeñaani, Sanŋalaa.))
256.instruction: (Aboo Hurayrah  reported that the Messenger of Allah  wiyi:'(Ɓe woodi) kumaaji ɗiɗi, (u) leecoo e nummoo, juutoo e Miinaa kan, yiɗaa e Yiurndee-juutoo la: (Subhanal-lahi wabihamdih, wasubhanal-lahil-AAatheem.))

257.translation: (Aboo Hurayrah fii ko Alla Kɛmɛ wiyi: 'Wiyoo: (Alla meeñaani, tanuu bɛɛ fɔ Alla la. Moolu te suutee moo la fo Ala, Alla bɛlaa.) ɓuri yiɗoo n la e bɛɛ weleerelaa feeñinii kan.)
257.instruction: (Aboo Hurayrah fii ko Alla Kɛmɛ wiyi: 'Wiyoo: (Subhanal-lah, walhamdu lillah, la ilaha illal-lah wallahu akbar.) ɓuri yiɗoo n la e bɛɛ weleerelaa feeñinii kan.)

258.translation: (Sa’d wiyi: 'An jooŋoo Alla Kɛmɛ la, a wiyi: 'Iɓe do te waaya heɓoo moƴƴeeji junnelu ñalnde koo?' Moo ɲinini a: Ko no moo heɓitoo moƴƴeeji junnelu? A jaabii: 'A ka wiyi: (Alla meeñaani.) biɲi teeme, sabu moƴƴeeji junnelu binndaa a la walla jumaŋooji junnelu suturaa.)
258.instruction: (Sa’d wiyi: 'An jooŋoo Alla Kɛmɛ la, a wiyi: 'Iɓe do te waaya heɓoo moƴƴeeji junnelu ñalnde koo?' Moo ɲinini a: Ko no moo heɓitoo moƴƴeeji junnelu? A jaabii: 'A ka wiyi: (Subhanal-lah.) biɲi teeme, sabu moƴƴeeji junnelu binndaa a la walla jumaŋooji junnelu suturaa.)

259.translation: (Jabbir fii ko Nelaa wiyi: 'Mo wiyi: (Alla meeñaani, Sanŋalaa, n A tanuu.) tamaroo-jin binndaa a la e jannat.)
259.instruction: (Jabbir fii ko Nelaa wiyi: 'Mo wiyi: (Subhanal-lahil-AAatheemi wabihamdih.) tamaroo-jin binndaa a la e jannat.)

260.translation: (AAabdullah Ibn Qays fii ko Nelaa wiyi a la: 'AAabdullah Ibn Qays, kana mi hollitoo I aanoo nder jannat aanooji?' A kɔfɛ wiyi: 'Wiyoo: (Alaa sembe walla se fo e Alla la.))
260.instruction: (AAabdullah Ibn Qays  fii ko Nelaa wiyi a la: 'AAabdullah Ibn Qays, kana mi hollitoo I aanoo nder jannat aanooji?' A kɔfɛ wiyi: 'Wiyoo: (La  hawla wala quwwata illa billah.))

261.translation: (Kumaaji yiɗaaɓe Alla la ko nɑɑ: (Alla meeñaani, tanuu bɛɛ fɔ Alla la. Moolu te suutee moo la fo Ala, Alla bɛlaa.))(ko tɛ, min I puɗɗinii e mum.)
261.instruction: (Kumaaji yiɗaaɓe Alla la ko nɑɑ: (Subhanal-lah, walhamdu lillah, wala ilaha illal-lah, wallahu akbar.))(ko tɛ, min I puɗɗinii e mum.)

262.translation: (SaAAd Ibn Abee Waqqas fii ko moo ɓaddii Alla Kɛmɛ la, wiyi a la: 'Kalannoo n ko n ka wiyi?' A wiyi: 'Wiyoo: (Moolu te suutee moo la fo Ala, A tokoo, alaa mɔɔ. Alla bɛlaa, tanuu ɗuuɗɗe fɔ Alla la. Alla meeñaani, adunaaruuji Maraa. Alaa sembe walla se fo e Alla la, Semmbe-baa, Xeeroo.) moo kɔfɛ wiyi: 'Ɗee ko n Maraa jago, min ko n jago?' A jaabii: 'Wiyoo:(Ala, yafara n, hinɛ kɛ n ma, fewin n, rizqino n.))
262.instruction: (SaAAd Ibn Abee Waqqas fii ko moo ɓaddii Alla Kɛmɛ la, wiyi a la: 'Kalannoo n ko n ka wiyi?' A wiyi: 'Wiyoo: (La ilaha illal-lah, wahdahu la shareeka lah, Allahu akbaru kabeera, walhamdu lillahi katheera, subhanal-lahi rabbil-AAalameen, la hawla wala quwwata illa billahil-AAazeezil-hakeem.) moo kɔfɛ wiyi: 'Ɗee ko n Maraa jago, min ko n jago?' A jaabii: 'Wiyoo:(Allahummagh-fir lee, warhamnee, wahdinee, warzuqnee.))

263.translation: (Tariq Al-AshjaAAee wiyi: 'So moo wallinii e Lislaam, Nelaa bɛ kalannoo a ko no a sariyitoo, kɔfɛ yamiroo a du'aa e kumaaji ɗee: (Ala, yafara n, hinɛ kɛ n ma, fewin n, tandoo n, rizqino n.))
263.instruction: (Tariq Al-AshjaAAee wiyi: 'So moo wallinii e Lislaam, Nelaa bɛ kalannoo a ko no a sariyitoo, kɔfɛ yamiroo a du'aa e kumaaji ɗee: (Allahummagh-fir lee, warhamnee, wahdinee, waAAafinee, warzuqnee.))

264.translation: (Jabir Ibn 'AAabdullah fii ko Alla Kɛmɛ wiyi: 'Tiɲɛtɛŋo, du'aa ɓurngoo moƴƴe ko: (Tanuu bɛɛ fɔ Alla la.) tiɲɛtɛŋo, mooftiirtee ɓurngoo moƴƴe ko: (Moolu te suutee moo la fo Ala.))
264.instruction: (Jabir Ibn 'AAabdullah fii ko Alla Kɛmɛ wiyi: 'Tiɲɛtɛŋo, du'aa ɓurngoo moƴƴe ko: (Alhamdu lillah) tiɲɛtɛŋo, mooftiirtee ɓurngoo moƴƴe ko: (La ilaha illal-lah.))

265.translation: Moƴƴeeji tootooɓe ko 'Alla meeñaani.', nin 'Tanuu fɔ Alla la.', nin 'Moo tɛ foti suutee fo Alla.', nin 'Alla bɛlaa', nin 'Alaa sembe walla se fo e Alla la'
265.instruction: Moƴƴeeji tootooɓe ko 'Subhaanallaah.', nin 'Walhamdulillaah.', nin 'Wa laa ilaaha illallaah'., nin 'Wallaahu Akbar', nin 'Wa laa hawla wa laa guwawala illaa billaah'.

266.translation: (Tasbeeh, o kɔrɔ ɗoo, a fɔ: (Subhanal-lah, alhamdu lillah, Allahu akbar.)) (AAabdullah Ibn AAamr kuma: 'N ɲaahii Nelaa tasbeeh kɛ a boloo ñaamere la.)

267.translation: N'a suunoo bɛ don, i denw don soo kɔnɔ sabu setaniw bɛ jɛ sahaa o. O kɔfɛ su waati kelen (o kɔrɔ su waati fukkoo) tɛmɛna, (i bɛ se) u (denw) ɓeytinaa. I daaw datugu, i bɛ Ala tɔgɔ fɔ, sabu setani tɛ da datugulen da. I jii kɛnɛw min, i bɛ Ala tɔgɔ fɔ. I fɛɛn kɛnɛw datugu, i bɛ Ala tɔgɔ fɔ hali n'i bɛ fɛn dɔrɔn a kan, i fitiliw fi. Hɛrɛ nin barika bɛ an Nelaa Muhammad kan, a baara kan nin a jokkuɓe kan, u bɛɛ.

name-1.instruction: O min bɛ ɲuman nin nafa feera A daadaa bɛɛ ma | Quran: (1:3) (17:110)

name-2.instruction: O min bɛ baara kɛ hinɛ caya la | Quran: (2:163) (3: 31) (4:100) (5:3)

name-3.instruction: Mansaa soba, O min jogoo laamu dafalen, O min laamu laaɓii e alaa-meeñugoo | Quran: (20:114)(23:116)(59:23)(62:1)

name-4.instruction: O laaɓii e alaa-meeñugoo koo, sanŋa e ɓiɓɓe nin ginoowoɓe | Quran: (59:23) (62:1)

name-5.instruction: O min hokkoo saafee, jam nin hijoo-saafee. E tɔgɔ nin fɔli, an saafee fiiriroo an hoore nin u an yeeli la. | Quran: (59:23)

name-6.instruction: Tɔgɔ nin ko muur hali Muslimɓe la, sabu "Al-Mu'min" ummoroo tɔgɔ "Al-iman" min maanaa ko laadamoo, ɗo tɔgɔ "Al-Mu'minoune" (laadamintooɓe) ummoroo. | Quran: (59:23)

name-7.instruction: Mo jaɓoo A daadaa e A se e laawal bɛɛ, haalaa walla laawal alaa e adunaaruu nin walla goɗɗoo min doggoo A miirde. | Quran: (59:23)

name-8.instruction: Sanŋoo e A sanŋoo nin A bonyoo, El-Aziz maanaa e miijoo: O teddoo, sanŋoo e A daadaa ɲaahaaɗi. A baaroo alaa moo, moo te waaya A jaɓoo. | Quran: (3:6)(4:15 8)(9:40)(4 8:7)

name-9.instruction: Mawoo, se-banbaa e A bonyoo nin A semmbe te-jiŋoo. So A babaaroo tooñooɓe (alaa-ñiyaasoo nin juŋooɓe) A wallitoo A sariyoo e juutii. | Quran: (59:23)

name-10.instruction: O sanŋa e A daadaa, daadaa alaa foti miijoo bonyoo. | Quran: (59:23)

name-11.instruction: Dantoo woodugooji bɛɛ, ɲaŋooɓe walla saayaaɓe, yahitooɓe walla tooŋooɓe. | Quran: (6:102)(13:16)(39:62)(40:62)(59:24)

name-12.instruction: O ɓaɓɓitoo A daadaa e fisaani koo walla alaa-meeñugoo koo. | Quran: (59:24)

name-13.instruction: O hokkoo yeewal nin feeñal daadaa koo la, nder nin yaŋgoo. E ɢarab taaŋgoo, kuma nin maanaa ko jasooɗo (sculpteur). | Quran: (59:24)

name-14.instruction: O min yaafaroo ko O yiɗi mo O yiɗi la. | Quran: (20:82)(38:66)(39:5)(40:42)(71:10)

name-15.instruction: O min se si wallitoo daadaa bɛɛ A miirde la. | Quran: (13:16)(14:48)(38:65)(39:4)(40:16)

name-16.instruction: O min hokkoo jawtaree alaa heɓoo ko kɔfɛ | Quran: (3:8)(38:9)(38:35)

name-17.instruction: O min feccitoo daadaa koo la ko a jiiɓii | Quran: (51:58)

name-18.instruction: O min tokoo anndoo kɔfɛ-kɔfɛ nin muur kiddooji, e A anndee nin A xel. Tɔgɔ nin jaasoo ɓataa e tɔgoo kɔfɛ "Al-‘Alīm". | Quran: (34:26)

name-19.instruction: O min ko te waaya suuɗoo e mum, sabu A anndii bɛɛ, A hijoo bɛɛ. | Quran: (2:158)(3:92)(4:35)(24:41)(33:40)

name-20.instruction: O min ɓoggintoo A moƴƴee e xel. | Quran: (2:245)

name-21.instruction: O min ɓeytinaa, ɓeydoo, ɗuuɗoo a moƴƴee e xel. | Quran: (2:245)

name-22.instruction: O min tootoo tooñooɓe nin kaaɓooɓe e jiloo nin jaŋŋaralaa. | Quran: (95:5)

name-23.instruction: Liitintoo e maanaa ɓaɓɓintoo, O ɓaɓɓitoo sanŋoo, darajaa nin bɛluŋo daadaa la e adunaaruu ɗooɓoo nin e kɔfɛ. | Quran: (58:11)(6:83)

name-24.instruction: O min hokkoo sanŋoo nin ɓiyoo teddoo. | Quran: (3:26)

name-25.instruction: O min waawi jiloo, fitinoo baa koo. | Quran: (3:26)

name-26.instruction: O min menno nannaŋoo walla kumoo koo e A laamu min fuɗɗii e daadaa koo, O min fana menno A daadaa du'aaji jaabugoo u du'aaji. | Quran: (2:127)(2:256)(8:17)(49:1)

name-27.instruction: O min ko woodi walla kɛraa-woodugoo te waaya doggoo e mum, alaa huutooɗe ɲaahaa, alaat walla hoore-membere fitinoo. | Quran: (4:58)(17:1)(42:11)(42:27)

name-28.instruction: A le mu O sariyoo, faɗoo hakkunde daadaa ɗooɓoo nin e kɔfɛ, O tabbitintoo ñiyaasoo hakkunde daadaa, moo goɗɗo te waaya faɗoo hakkunde u no O. | Quran: (22:69)

name-29.instruction: O fisaani e alaa-ñiyaasoo joonooji bɛɛ nin/walla tooñoo. | Quran: (6:115)

name-30.instruction: O min hokkoo A daadaa A weecoo nin A moƴƴee. | Quran: (6:103)(22:63)(31:16)(33:34)

name-31.instruction: A le mu O min ko te suuɗoo e mum, goongaa fɛn koo woodi, o kɔrɔ fɛn goongaa; dɛtɛɛl te doggoo A, fɛn ɗuumoo walla a jekkuu koo; faamoo bɛɛ ko A la. | Quran: (6:18)(17:30)(49:13)(59:18)

name-32.instruction: O min muusoo juŋooɓe kaafiraaɓe kan kɔfɛ faamoo koo (se waawoo yafaa hokkiraa u). | Quran: (2:235)(17:44)(22:59)(35:41)

name-33.instruction: Tɔgɔ nin gɛlɛɛ kɛrɛnginoo sabu a jaŋŋarii kumaaji ɗuuɗɗi u ɓataa goonga miijoo kelen, a waawi ɓadiiroo no ɗoo: "Al-Adhīm" O Mawoo Sanŋoo bɛluŋo. | Quran: (2:255)(42:4)(56:96)

name-34.instruction: O min yaafaroo jawtaree lomtoo e lomtoo. | Quran: (2:173)(8:69)(16:110)(41:32)

name-35.instruction: O min hollitoo A juŋaŋaaroo baarooɓe la, hali baara weecoo juutii. | Quran: (35:30)(35:34)(42:23)(64:17)

name-36.instruction: O min sanŋa e bɛɛ A daani e laŋoo, faamoo-waayaa. | Quran: (4:34)(31:30)(42:4)(42:51)

name-37.instruction: Mawoo: O mawoo e A daadaa, bonyoo O tokoo anndoo. | Quran: (13:9)(22:62)(31:30)

name-38.instruction: O min kisoo, aanoo A moƴƴee. | Quran: (11:57)(34:21)(42:6)

name-39.instruction: kuma nin nder kuma taaŋgoo ɢarab; gɛlɛɛ kɛrɛnginoo hali e ɢarab kɛrɛŋ}. A maanaa: O min accaa dɛtɛɛl so A sariyoo, hali fitinoo juutii. | Quran: (4:85)

name-41.instruction: O min laaɓii bɛɛ e wiitoo A no A daadaa, walla woodugoo O no A. | Quran: (55:27)(39:14)(7:143)

name-45.instruction: Tɔgɔ nin e ɢarab maanaa: yawtaree juutii, O wiitoo Alla a faamaa A ɓuuɓnii kooŋoo bɛɛ, A jaŋŋarii fɛn bɛɛ e sira O tokoo anndoo. | Quran: (2:268)(3:73)(5:54)

name-50.instruction: Seedee: Alla le mu seedee banbaa nin dafalen fɛn bɛɛ min kɛni A laamu kɔnɔ, e seedee ɲɛlen, bɛɛ yeewa, dafalen te jiloo. | Quran: (4:166)(22:17)(41:53)(48:28)

name-57.instruction: kɛrɛnginoo bukkuu no jateeɗo, a maanaa ko O min jatee daadaa koo, baara koo, ŋuŋŋoo koo e A laamu, ko te doggoo A anndee. | Quran: (72:28)(78:29)(82:10-12)

name-62.instruction: Ɲaŋooɗo: O min fuɗɗaa-woodugoo, a woodi, O min jogoo hayah, u meeñi nin ko ɲaŋo no daadaa hayah min feeree e feereeji... | Quran: (2:255)(3:2)(25:58)(40:65)
